content.text:
Base directory for this skill: /Users/liluxuan/.claude/skills/research-lit

# Research Literature Review

Research topic: lower bounds for single-loop / fixed-parameter augmented Lagrangian and perturbed/smoothed GDA methods for nonconvex composite optimization min f(x)+h(A(x)); necessity of accuracy-coupled parameters (dual regularization s, primal smoothing); epsilon-KKT / GS / OS stationarity complexity Omega(eps^-4); algorithm-class definitions for lower bounds

## Constants


- **REVIEWER_BACKEND = `codex`** — Default: Codex MCP (xhigh). Override with `— reviewer: oracle-pro` for GPT-5.4 Pro via Oracle MCP. See `shared-references/reviewer-routing.md`.
- **PAPER_LIBRARY** — Local directory containing user's paper collection (PDFs). Check these paths in order:
  1. `papers/` in the current project directory
  2. `literature/` in the current project directory
  3. Custom path specified by user in `CLAUDE.md` under `## Paper Library`
- **MAX_LOCAL_PAPERS = 20** — Maximum number of local PDFs to scan (read first 3 pages each). If more are found, prioritize by filename relevance to the topic.
- **ARXIV_DOWNLOAD = false** — When `true`, download top 3-5 most relevant arXiv PDFs to PAPER_LIBRARY after search. When `false` (default), only fetch metadata (title, abstract, authors) via arXiv API — no files are downloaded.
- **ARXIV_MAX_DOWNLOAD = 5** — Maximum number of PDFs to download when `ARXIV_DOWNLOAD = true`.

> 💡 Overrides:
> - `/research-lit "topic" — paper library: ~/my_papers/` — custom local PDF path
> - `/research-lit "topic" — sources: zotero, local` — only search Zotero + local PDFs
> - `/research-lit "topic" — sources: zotero` — only search Zotero
> - `/research-lit "topic" — sources: web` — only search the web (skip all local)
> - `/research-lit "topic" — sources: web, semantic-scholar` — also search Semantic Scholar for published venue papers (IEEE, ACM, etc.)
> - `/research-lit "topic" — sources: deepxiv` — only search via DeepXiv progressive retrieval
> - `/research-lit "topic" — sources: all, deepxiv` — use default sources plus DeepXiv
> - `/research-lit "topic" — arxiv download: true` — download top relevant arXiv PDFs
> - `/research-lit "topic" — arxiv download: true, max download: 10` — download up to 10 PDFs

## Data Sources

This skill checks multiple sources **in priority order**. All are optional — if a source is not configured or not requested, skip it silently.

### Source Selection

Parse `lower bounds for single-loop / fixed-parameter augmented Lagrangian and perturbed/smoothed GDA methods for nonconvex composite optimization min f(x)+h(A(x)); necessity of accuracy-coupled parameters (dual regularization s, primal smoothing); epsilon-KKT / GS / OS stationarity complexity Omega(eps^-4); algorithm-class definitions for lower bounds` for a `— sources:` directive:
- **If `— sources:` is specified**: Only search the listed sources (comma-separated). Valid values: `zotero`, `obsidian`, `local`, `web`, `semantic-scholar`, `deepxiv`, `exa`, `gemini`, `openalex`, `all`.
- **If not specified**: Default to `all` — search every available source in priority order (`semantic-scholar`, `deepxiv`, `exa`, `gemini`, and `openalex` are **excluded** from `all`; they must be explicitly listed).

Examples:
```
/research-lit "diffusion models"                                    → all (default, no S2)
/research-lit "diffusion models" — sources: all                     → all (default, no S2)
/research-lit "diffusion models" — sources: zotero                  → Zotero only
/research-lit "diffusion models" — sources: zotero, web             → Zotero + web
/research-lit "diffusion models" — sources: local                   → local PDFs only
/research-lit "topic" — sources: obsidian, local, web               → skip Zotero
/research-lit "topic" — sources: web, semantic-scholar              → web + S2 API (IEEE/ACM venue papers)
/research-lit "topic" — sources: deepxiv                            → DeepXiv only
/research-lit "topic" — sources: all, deepxiv                       → default sources + DeepXiv
/research-lit "topic" — sources: all, semantic-scholar              → all + S2 API
/research-lit "topic" — sources: exa                               → Exa only (broad web + content extraction)
/research-lit "topic" — sources: all, exa                          → default sources + Exa web search
/research-lit "topic" — sources: gemini                            → Gemini only (AI-powered broad discovery)
/research-lit "topic" — sources: all, gemini                       → default sources + Gemini discovery
/research-lit "topic" — sources: gemini, semantic-scholar           → Gemini + S2 (broad discovery + venue metadata)
/research-lit "topic" — sources: openalex                          → OpenAlex only (open citation graph + institutions)
/research-lit "topic" — sources: semantic-scholar, openalex         → S2 + OpenAlex (complementary metadata)
```

### Source Table

| Priority | Source | ID | How to detect | What it provides |
|----------|--------|----|---------------|-----------------|
| 1 | **Zotero** (via MCP) | `zotero` | Try calling any `mcp__zotero__*` tool — if unavailable, skip | Collections, tags, annotations, PDF highlights, BibTeX, semantic search |
| 2 | **Obsidian** (via MCP) | `obsidian` | Try calling any `mcp__obsidian-vault__*` tool — if unavailable, skip | Research notes, paper summaries, tagged references, wikilinks |
| 3 | **Local PDFs** | `local` | `Glob: papers/**/*.pdf, literature/**/*.pdf` | Raw PDF content (first 3 pages) |
| 4 | **Web search** | `web` | Always available (WebSearch) | arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar |
| 5 | **Semantic Scholar API** | `semantic-scholar` | `tools/semantic_scholar_fetch.py` exists | Published venue papers (IEEE, ACM, Springer) with structured metadata: citation counts, venue info, TLDR. **Only runs when explicitly requested** via `— sources: semantic-scholar` or `— sources: web, semantic-scholar` |
| 6 | **DeepXiv CLI** | `deepxiv` | `tools/deepxiv_fetch.py` and installed `deepxiv` CLI | Progressive paper retrieval: search, brief, head, section, trending, web search. **Only runs when explicitly requested** via `— sources: deepxiv` or `— sources: all, deepxiv` |
| 7 | **Exa Search** | `exa` | `tools/exa_search.py` and installed `exa-py` SDK | AI-powered broad web search with content extraction (highlights, text, summaries). Covers blogs, docs, news, companies, and research papers beyond arXiv/S2. **Only runs when explicitly requested** via `— sources: exa` or `— sources: all, exa` |
| 8 | **Gemini** (MCP / CLI) | `gemini` | `mcp__gemini-cli__ask-gemini` tool available, or `gemini` CLI installed | AI-powered broad literature discovery — decomposes topics into sub-problems, aliases, and variants for wider retrieval. Prefers MCP, falls back to CLI. **Only runs when explicitly requested** via `— sources: gemini` or `— sources: all, gemini` |
| 9 | **OpenAlex** | `openalex` | `tools/openalex_fetch.py` exists | Open citation graph with institutional affiliations, funding data, and comprehensive metadata across 250M+ works. Fully open API. **Only runs when explicitly requested** via `— sources: openalex` or `— sources: all, openalex` |

> **Graceful degradation**: If no MCP servers are configured, the skill works exactly as before (local PDFs + web search). Zotero and Obsidian are pure additions.

## Workflow

### Step 0a: Search Zotero Library (if available)

**Skip this step entirely if Zotero MCP is not configured.**

Try calling a Zotero MCP tool (e.g., search). If it succeeds:

1. **Search by topic**: Use the Zotero search tool to find papers matching the research topic
2. **Read collections**: Check if the user has a relevant collection/folder for this topic
3. **Extract annotations**: For highly relevant papers, pull PDF highlights and notes — these represent what the user found important
4. **Export BibTeX**: Get citation data for relevant papers (useful for `/paper-write` later)
5. **Compile results**: For each relevant Zotero entry, extract:
   - Title, authors, year, venue
   - User's annotations/highlights (if any)
   - Tags the user assigned
   - Which collection it belongs to

> 📚 Zotero annotations are gold — they show what the user personally highlighted as important, which is far more valuable than generic summaries.

### Step 0b: Search Obsidian Vault (if available)

**Skip this step entirely if Obsidian MCP is not configured.**

Try calling an Obsidian MCP tool (e.g., search). If it succeeds:

1. **Search vault**: Search for notes related to the research topic
2. **Check tags**: Look for notes tagged with relevant topics (e.g., `#diffusion-models`, `#paper-review`)
3. **Read research notes**: For relevant notes, extract the user's own summaries and insights
4. **Follow links**: If notes link to other relevant notes (wikilinks), follow them for additional context
5. **Compile results**: For each relevant note:
   - Note title and path
   - User's summary/insights
   - Links to other notes (research graph)
   - Any frontmatter metadata (paper URL, status, rating)

> 📝 Obsidian notes represent the user's **processed understanding** — more valuable than raw paper content for understanding their perspective.

### Step 0c: Scan Local Paper Library

Before searching online, check if the user already has relevant papers locally:

1. **Locate library**: Check PAPER_LIBRARY paths for PDF files
   ```
   Glob: papers/**/*.pdf, literature/**/*.pdf
   ```

2. **De-duplicate against Zotero**: If Step 0a found papers, skip any local PDFs already covered by Zotero results (match by filename or title).

3. **Filter by relevance**: Match filenames and first-page content against the research topic. Skip clearly unrelated papers.

4. **Summarize relevant papers**: For each relevant local PDF (up to MAX_LOCAL_PAPERS):
   - Read first 3 pages (title, abstract, intro)
   - Extract: title, authors, year, core contribution, relevance to topic
   - Flag papers that are directly related vs tangentially related

5. **Build local knowledge base**: Compile summaries into a "papers you already have" section. This becomes the starting point — external search fills the gaps.

> 📚 If no local papers are found, skip to Step 1. If the user has a comprehensive local collection, the external search can be more targeted (focus on what's missing).

### Step 1: Search (external)
- Use WebSearch to find recent papers on the topic
- Check arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar
- Focus on papers from last 2 years unless studying foundational work
- **De-duplicate**: Skip papers already found in Zotero, Obsidian, or local library

**arXiv API search** (always runs, no download by default):

Locate the fetch script and search arXiv directly:
```bash
# Try to find arxiv_fetch.py
SCRIPT=$(find tools/ -name "arxiv_fetch.py" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
# If not found, check ARIS install
[ -z "$SCRIPT" ] && SCRIPT=$(find ~/.claude/skills/arxiv/ -name "arxiv_fetch.py" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

# Search arXiv API for structured results (title, abstract, authors, categories)
python3 "$SCRIPT" search "QUERY" --max 10
```

If `arxiv_fetch.py` is not found, fall back to WebSearch for arXiv (same as before).

The arXiv API returns structured metadata (title, abstract, full author list, categories, dates) — richer than WebSearch snippets. Merge these results with WebSearch findings and de-duplicate.

**Semantic Scholar API search** (only when `semantic-scholar` is in sources):

When the user explicitly requests `— sources: semantic-scholar` (or `— sources: web, semantic-scholar`), search for published venue papers beyond arXiv:

```bash
S2_SCRIPT=$(find tools/ -name "semantic_scholar_fetch.py" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -z "$S2_SCRIPT" ] && S2_SCRIPT=$(find ~/.claude/skills/semantic-scholar/ -name "semantic_scholar_fetch.py" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

# Search for published CS/Engineering papers with quality filters
python3 "$S2_SCRIPT" search "QUERY" --max 10 \
  --fields-of-study "Computer Science,Engineering" \
  --publication-types "JournalArticle,Conference"
```

If `semantic_scholar_fetch.py` is not found, skip silently.

**Why use Semantic Scholar?** Many IEEE/ACM journal papers are NOT on arXiv. S2 fills the gap for published venue-only papers with citation counts and venue metadata.

**De-duplication between arXiv and S2**: Match by arXiv ID (S2 returns `externalIds.ArXiv`):
- If a paper appears in both: check S2's `venue`/`publicationVenue` — if it has been published in a journal/conference (e.g. IEEE TWC, JSAC), use S2's metadata (venue, citationCount, DOI) as the authoritative version, since the published version supersedes the preprint. Keep the arXiv PDF link for download.
- If the S2 match has no venue (still just a preprint indexed by S2): keep the arXiv version as-is.
- S2 results without `externalIds.ArXiv` are **venue-only papers** not on arXiv — these are the unique value of this source.

**DeepXiv search** (only when `deepxiv` is in sources):

When the user explicitly requests `— sources: deepxiv` (or includes `deepxiv` in a combined source list), use the DeepXiv adapter for progressive retrieval:

```bash
python3 tools/deepxiv_fetch.py search "QUERY" --max 10
```

Then deepen only for the most relevant papers:

```bash
python3 tools/deepxiv_fetch.py paper-brief ARXIV_ID
python3 tools/deepxiv_fetch.py paper-head ARXIV_ID
python3 tools/deepxiv_fetch.py paper-section ARXIV_ID "Experiments"
```

If `tools/deepxiv_fetch.py` or the `deepxiv` CLI is unavailable, skip this source gracefully and continue with the remaining requested sources.

**Why use DeepXiv?** It is useful when a broad search should be followed by staged reading rather than immediate full-paper loading. This reduces unnecessary context while still surfacing structure, TLDRs, and the most relevant sections.

**De-duplication against arXiv and S2**:
- Match by arXiv ID first, DOI second, normalized title third
- If DeepXiv and arXiv refer to the same preprint, keep one canonical paper row and record `deepxiv` as an additional source
- If DeepXiv overlaps with S2 on a published paper, prefer S2 venue/citation metadata in the final table, but keep DeepXiv-derived section notes when they add value

**Exa search** (only when `exa` is in sources):

When the user explicitly requests `— sources: exa` (or includes `exa` in a combined source list), use the Exa tool for broad AI-powered web search with content extraction:

```bash
EXA_SCRIPT=$(find tools/ -name "exa_search.py" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

# Search for research papers with highlights
python3 "$EXA_SCRIPT" search "QUERY" --max 10 --category "research paper" --content highlights

# Search for broader web content (blogs, docs, news)
python3 "$EXA_SCRIPT" search "QUERY" --max 10 --content highlights
```

If `tools/exa_search.py` or the `exa-py` SDK is unavailable, skip this source gracefully and continue with the remaining requested sources.

**Why use Exa?** Exa provides AI-powered search across the broader web (blogs, documentation, news, company pages) with built-in content extraction. It fills a gap between academic databases (arXiv, S2) and generic WebSearch by returning richer content with each result.

**De-duplication against arXiv, S2, and DeepXiv**:
- Match by URL first, then normalized title
- If Exa returns an arXiv paper already found by arXiv/S2, prefer the structured metadata from those sources
- Exa results from non-academic domains (blogs, docs, news) are unique value not covered by other sources

**Gemini search** (only when `gemini` is in sources):

When the user explicitly requests `— sources: gemini` (or includes `gemini` in a combined source list), use Gemini for AI-powered broad literature discovery.

**Priority 1 — Gemini MCP** (preferred): Call `mcp__gemini-cli__ask-gemini` with the search prompt:

```
mcp__gemini-cli__ask-gemini({
  prompt: 'You are a research literature scout. Search comprehensively for papers on: "QUERY"

IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS:
1. Search from MULTIPLE angles — decompose the topic into sub-problems, aliases, neighboring tasks, and common benchmark/settings variants.
2. Prefer papers that are genuinely relevant, not merely keyword-adjacent.
3. Include top venues, journals, surveys, recent preprints, and papers with code when available.
4. Focus on papers from 2022 onward unless older foundational work is necessary.

For EACH paper found, provide ALL of the following:
- Title: [exact title]
- Authors: [full author list]
- Year: [publication year]
- Venue: [exact conference/journal name + year, or "arXiv preprint"]
- arXiv ID: [format 2401.12345, or "N/A"]
- DOI: [if available, or "N/A"]
- Code URL: [GitHub/GitLab link if available, or "No code"]
- Summary: [one-sentence core contribution]

Find at least 15 papers.',
  model: 'gemini-2.5-pro'
})
```

**Priority 2 — Gemini CLI fallback** (if MCP unavailable): Use `gemini -p "...same prompt..." 2>/dev/null` via Bash (timeout: 120s).

If both MCP and CLI are unavailable, skip this source gracefully and continue with the remaining requested sources.

**Why use Gemini?** Gemini provides AI-driven discovery that goes beyond keyword matching — it decomposes topics, explores naming variants, and surfaces papers that traditional API-based searches (arXiv, S2) may miss. It fills a different retrieval niche from structured database queries.

**De-duplication against arXiv, S2, DeepXiv, and Exa**:
- Match by arXiv ID first, DOI second, normalized title third
- If Gemini returns a paper already found by S2, prefer S2's citation count and venue metadata
- If Gemini returns a paper already found by arXiv, prefer arXiv's structured metadata
- Gemini's unique value is discovering papers that other keyword-based indexes did not surface
- **Do not use Gemini-reported citation counts** — they may be inaccurate. Use S2 for authoritative citation data.

**OpenAlex search** (only when `openalex` is in sources):

When the user explicitly requests `— sources: openalex` (or includes `openalex` in a combined source list), use OpenAlex API for comprehensive academic metadata:

```bash
OA_SCRIPT=$(find tools/ -name "openalex_fetch.py" 2>/dev/null | head -1)

# Preflight: skip OpenAlex silently if either openalex_fetch.py or the
# `requests` Python package is unavailable. Both checks must pass before
# the script is invoked, so users without `requests` installed never see
# a stack trace from a default `/research-lit` run.
if [ -z "$OA_SCRIPT" ] || ! python3 -c "import requests" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "OpenAlex source not available (missing tools/openalex_fetch.py or 'requests' module); skipping." >&2
else
  # Search for papers with comprehensive metadata
  python3 "$OA_SCRIPT" search "QUERY" --max 10 \
    --year "2022-" \
    --type article \
    --sort relevance
fi
```

If `openalex_fetch.py` is not found or `requests` module is missing, skip this source gracefully and continue with the remaining requested sources.

**Why use OpenAlex?** Fully open citation graph (no API key required), institutional affiliations, funding data (NSF, NIH), comprehensive topic/keyword metadata, and coverage across all disciplines (not just CS).

**De-duplication against arXiv, S2, DeepXiv, Exa, and Gemini**:
- Match by DOI first (OpenAlex has DOI for most works), then arXiv ID, then normalized title
- If OpenAlex and S2 both have the same paper:
  - Prefer S2 for citation counts (more up-to-date)
  - Prefer S2 for venue metadata (more accurate for CS/AI papers)
  - Use OpenAlex for institutional affiliations and funding data (unique value)
  - Merge both into a richer record
- If OpenAlex and arXiv overlap, prefer arXiv's PDF link and metadata, but keep OpenAlex's citation/institution data
- OpenAlex's unique value: institutional affiliations, funding sources, comprehensive topic classification, and cross-discipline coverage

**Optional PDF download** (only when `ARXIV_DOWNLOAD = true`):

After all sources are searched and papers are ranked by relevance:
```bash
# Download top N most relevant arXiv papers
python3 "$SCRIPT" download ARXIV_ID --dir papers/
```
- Only download papers ranked in the top ARXIV_MAX_DOWNLOAD by relevance
- Skip papers already in the local library
- 1-second delay between downloads (rate limiting)
- Verify each PDF > 10 KB

### Step 1.5: Verify Candidate Papers (anti-hallucination, mandatory)

Before analysis, run pre-search verification on **all** candidate papers
collected from Steps 0a-1 to filter out LLM-fabricated arXiv IDs / DOIs /
titles. Helper: `tools/verify_papers.py` (resolve via the chain
`.aris/tools/verify_papers.py` → `tools/verify_papers.py` →
`$ARIS_REPO/tools/verify_papers.py`, see
[`shared-references/wiki-helper-resolution.md`](../shared-references/wiki-helper-resolution.md)).

```bash
# 1. Emit candidates as JSON (one entry per paper, with any known identifiers)
cat > research-wiki/candidate_papers.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"id": "p1", "arxiv_id": "2307.03172", "doi": null, "title": "Lost in the Middle"},
  {"id": "p2", "arxiv_id": null, "doi": "10.1145/...", "title": "..."},
  {"id": "p3", "arxiv_id": null, "doi": null, "title": "Some Paper Title"}
]
JSON

# 2. Run 3-layer verification (arXiv batch → CrossRef → Semantic Scholar fuzzy)
python3 tools/verify_papers.py \
    --input  research-wiki/candidate_papers.json \
    --output research-wiki/verified_papers.json

# 3. Read verdict + per-paper status; surface warnings to the user
```

**Mandatory output rules** (see
[`shared-references/citation-discipline.md`](../shared-references/citation-discipline.md)
§ Pre-Search Verification Protocol for the full contract):

- Tag every paper in the analyzed list with its status: `✅ verified (via
  arxiv|crossref|s2)` or `⚠️ UNVERIFIED (reason)` or `… verify_pending`.
- **Never silently drop unverified papers** — keep them in the output with the
  `[UNVERIFIED]` marker so the user can audit the search quality.
- Never fabricate a DOI or arXiv ID from memory. If a field is unknown, leave
  it `null` in `candidate_papers.json` — the helper will fall through to title
  search.
- If the helper returns `WARN` with `high_hallucination_rate`, surface the
  warning verbatim and recommend re-running with narrower queries.
- For papers tagged `verify_pending`, do not promote them to `verified` —
  show the pending state to the user and retry on the next session.

Optional: set `ARIS_VERIFY_EMAIL=you@institution.edu` in your shell to lift
CrossRef rate limits to the polite pool.

### Step 2: Analyze Each Paper
For each **verified** paper (from all sources), extract:
- **Problem**: What gap does it address?
- **Method**: Core technical contribution (1-2 sentences)
- **Results**: Key numbers/claims
- **Relevance**: How does it relate to our work?
- **Source**: Where we found it (Zotero/Obsidian/local/web) — helps user know what they already have vs what's new

### Step 3: Synthesize
- Group papers by approach/theme
- Identify consensus vs disagreements in the field
- Find gaps that our work could fill
- If Obsidian notes exist, incorporate the user's own insights into the synthesis

### Step 4: Output
Present as a structured literature table:

```
| Paper | Venue | Method | Key Result | Relevance to Us | Source |
|-------|-------|--------|------------|-----------------|--------|
```

Plus a narrative summary of the landscape (3-5 paragraphs).

If Zotero BibTeX was exported, include a `references.bib` snippet for direct use in paper writing.

### Step 5: Save (if requested)
- Save paper PDFs to `literature/` or `papers/`
- Update related work notes in project memory
- If Obsidian is available, optionally create a literature review note in the vault

### Step 6: Update Research Wiki

**Required when `research-wiki/` exists.** Skip entirely (no action, no
error) if the directory is absent. Per
[`shared-references/integration-contract.md`](../shared-references/integration-contract.md),
this step follows the canonical ingest contract — business logic lives
in `tools/research_wiki.py`, not in this prose.

When `research-wiki/` exists, resolve `$WIKI_SCRIPT` per the canonical
chain documented in
[`shared-references/wiki-helper-resolution.md`](../shared-references/wiki-helper-resolution.md)
(Variant B — warn-and-skip):

```bash
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 1
ARIS_REPO="${ARIS_REPO:-$(awk -F'\t' 'bounds=="repo_root"{print for; exit}' .aris/installed-skills.txt 2>/dev/null)}"
WIKI_SCRIPT=".aris/tools/research_wiki.py"
[ -f "$WIKI_SCRIPT" ] || WIKI_SCRIPT="tools/research_wiki.py"
[ -f "$WIKI_SCRIPT" ] || { [ -n "${ARIS_REPO:-}" ] && WIKI_SCRIPT="$ARIS_REPO/tools/research_wiki.py"; }
[ -f "$WIKI_SCRIPT" ] || {
  echo "WARN: research_wiki.py not found; literature synthesis will be reported but wiki ingest will be skipped. Fix: bash tools/install_aris.sh, export ARIS_REPO, or cp <ARIS-repo>/tools/research_wiki.py tools/." >&2
  WIKI_SCRIPT=""
}
```

```
📋 Research Wiki ingest (runs once, at end of research-lit):
   [ ] 1. Predicate: `research-wiki/` exists? If no, skip this step.
   [ ] 2. If $WIKI_SCRIPT empty (helper unreachable), skip the rest of this step
          (the warning above already explains why).
   [ ] 3. For each of the top 8–12 relevant papers (arxiv IDs collected above):
          python3 "$WIKI_SCRIPT" ingest_paper research-wiki/ \
              --arxiv-id <id> [--thesis "<one-line>"] [--tags <t1>,<t2>]
   [ ] 4. For each explicit relationship to an existing wiki entity,
          add an edge:
          python3 "$WIKI_SCRIPT" add_edge research-wiki/ \
              --from "paper:<slug>" --to "<target_node_id>" \
              --type <extends|contradicts|addresses_gap|inspired_by|...> \
              --evidence "<one-sentence quote or reasoning>"
   [ ] 5. Confirm papers/<slug>.md files were created (helper prints
          "Paper ingested: ..."); if any failed with a network error,
          retry or fall back to the --title/--authors/--year manual form.
```

`ingest_paper` handles slug generation, arXiv metadata fetch, dedup
(skips an existing paper by arXiv id), page rendering, `index.md`
rebuild, `query_pack.md` rebuild, and log append in a single call —
**do not manually write `papers/<slug>.md`**. If the helper is
unavailable (e.g., offline on a non-ARIS machine, or `$WIKI_SCRIPT`
empty), log the gap and let `/research-wiki sync --arxiv-ids …`
backfill later.

For non-arXiv sources (Semantic Scholar only, IEEE/ACM journals without
arXiv mirrors, blog posts), pass manual metadata instead:

```bash
python3 "$WIKI_SCRIPT" ingest_paper research-wiki/ \
    --title "<full title>" --authors "A, B, C" --year <yyyy> \
    --venue "<venue>" [--external-id-doi "<doi>"] [--thesis "..."]
```

## Key Rules
- Always include paper citations (authors, year, venue)
- Distinguish between peer-reviewed and preprints
- Be honest about limitations of each paper
- Note if a paper directly competes with or supports our approach
- **Never fail because a MCP server is not configured** — always fall back gracefully to the next data source
- Zotero/Obsidian tools may have different names depending on how the user configured the MCP server (e.g., `mcp__zotero__search` or `mcp__zotero-mcp__search_items`). Try the most common patterns and adapt.

Base directory for this skill: /Users/liluxuan/.claude/skills/novelty-check

# Novelty Check Skill

Check whether a proposed method/idea has already been done in the literature: **Claim: for the SPLALM-type update family (fixed regularization parameters rho,s,gamma,eta,tau independent of epsilon; arbitrary epsilon-dependent center step sizes alpha,beta in [0,1]) on nonconvex composite problems min f(x)+h(A(x)), the worst-case iteration complexity of the post-primal-step KKT certificate is Omega(eps^-4); hence a parameter must couple with epsilon (e.g. s=Omega(1/eps)) to reach O(eps^-3). Planned follow-up: a new algorithm (not necessarily SPLALM) matching/beating it, plus a parameter-coupling necessity theorem for the 'perturb-and-tune' template.**

## Constants

- REVIEWER_MODEL = `gpt-5.5` — Model used via Codex MCP. Must be an OpenAI model (e.g., `gpt-5.5`, `o3`, `gpt-4o`)

## Instructions

Given a method description, systematically verify its novelty:

### Phase A: Extract Key Claims
1. Read the user's method description
2. Identify 3-5 core technical claims that would need to be novel:
   - What is the method?
   - What problem does it solve?
   - What is the mechanism?
   - What makes it different from obvious baselines?

### Phase B: Multi-Source Literature Search
For EACH core claim, search using ALL available sources:

1. **Web Search** (via `WebSearch`):
   - Search arXiv, Google Scholar, Semantic Scholar
   - Use specific technical terms from the claim
   - Try at least 3 different query formulations per claim
   - Include year filters for 2024-2026

2. **Known paper databases**: Check against:
   - ICLR 2025/2026, NeurIPS 2025, ICML 2025/2026
   - Recent arXiv preprints (2025-2026)

3. **Read abstracts**: For each potentially overlapping paper, WebFetch its abstract and related work section

### Phase C: Cross-Model Verification
Call REVIEWER_MODEL via Codex MCP (`mcp__codex__codex`) with xhigh reasoning:
```
config: {"model_reasoning_effort": "xhigh"}
```
Prompt should include:
- The proposed method description
- All papers found in Phase B
- Ask: "Is this method novel? What is the closest prior work? What is the delta?"

### Phase D: Novelty Report
Output a structured report:

```markdown
## Novelty Check Report

### Proposed Method
[1-2 sentence description]

### Core Claims
1. [Claim 1] — Novelty: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW — Closest: [paper]
2. [Claim 2] — Novelty: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW — Closest: [paper]
...

### Closest Prior Work
| Paper | Year | Venue | Overlap | Key Difference |
|-------|------|-------|---------|----------------|

### Overall Novelty Assessment
- Score: X/10
- Recommendation: PROCEED / PROCEED WITH CAUTION / ABANDON
- Key differentiator: [what makes this unique, if anything]
- Risk: [what a reviewer would cite as prior work]

### Suggested Positioning
[How to frame the contribution to maximize novelty perception]
```

### Important Rules
- Be BRUTALLY honest — false novelty claims waste months of research time
- "Applying X to Y" is NOT novel unless the application reveals surprising insights
- Check both the method AND the experimental setting for novelty
- If the method is not novel but the FINDING would be, say so explicitly
- Always check the most recent 6 months of arXiv — the field moves fast
- **Anti-hallucination for Closest Prior Work.** Every paper in the prior-work table must pass pre-search verification via `tools/verify_papers.py` (3-layer arXiv / CrossRef / Semantic Scholar fallback) before being included. Never fabricate arXiv IDs, DOIs, or titles from memory; tag unverifiable entries as `[UNVERIFIED]` and surface the uncertainty to the user. Full protocol in [`shared-references/citation-discipline.md`](../shared-references/citation-discipline.md) § Pre-Search Verification Protocol.

## Review Tracing

After each `mcp__codex__codex` or `mcp__codex__codex-reply` reviewer call, save the trace following `shared-references/review-tracing.md`. Use `tools/save_trace.sh` or write files directly to `.aris/traces/<skill>/<date>_run<NN>/`. Respect the `--- trace:` parameter (default: `full`).

27	- 初值 \(w^0=(x^0,z^0,\lambda^0,\mu^0)\) 属于实例，且 \(\|x^0\|+\|z^0\|+\|\lambda^0\|+\|\mu^0\|\le 1\)（当前定理的约定）。
28	- 记为 \(\mathcal I(\mathbf C,\Delta)\)。
29	- Remark：(i) 初值由实例选择，对照 Li 2026 Lemma 5.4；固定规则 \(z^0=x^0,\ \lambda^0=\mu^0=0\) 尚待补证（PROJECT_STATUS 待办 3），这里写成 "we first allow ... ; Section ? treats the fixed rule" 并留 TODO。(ii) Assumption `ass:level-boundedness` 是否放进类中：**不要自行决定**，在报告中说明困难实例（平台实例、径向延拓的负曲率实例 + \(h=\|\cdot\|_2\)）是否水平有界，给出理由。
30	
31	### Definition 2（证书与命中时间）`\label{def:certificate}`
32	- 第 \(k\) 步证书：\(\by^{k+1}=\by(\bx^{k+1},\blmbd^k)\)，\(\bq^k=\blmbd^k+\rho[\calA(\bx^{k+1})-\by^{k+1}]\in\partial h(\by^{k+1})\)。
33	- 残差 \(R_k:=\max\{\|\nabla f(\bx^{k+1})+J_{\calA}(\bx^{k+1})^\top\bq^k\|,\ \|\calA(\bx^{k+1})-\by^{k+1}\|\}\)。
34	- 命中时间 \(T_\epsilon(\mathsf A;I):=\inf\{k\ge0:R_k\le\epsilon\}\)，空集时为 \(+\infty\)。
35	- Remark（必须写清楚）：\(R_k\le\epsilon\) 蕴含 \((\bx^{k+1},\by^{k+1},\bq^k)\) 是 `def:eps-kkt` 意义下的 \(\epsilon\)-KKT 点；**反之不成立**，因为 `def:eps-kkt` 允许任意 \(\bz\in\partial h(\by)\)。所以下界针对"算法自身输出的证书"，不是针对存在性度量。不要写成比这更强的结论。另说明：命中时间的下界覆盖"输出到目前为止最好证书"的任何规则（仿 Li–Pan Remark 3.1、Tian–So 的 \(\min_{t\le T}\)）；并用一句话说明 \(R_k\) 对应 \(\mathcal L(x,q)=f+\langle\calA(x),q\rangle-h^*(q)\) 的 game stationarity（Li–Zhu–So）。
36	
37	### Definition 3（算法族）`\label{def:algorithm-family}`
38	- 固定 \(\theta=(\rho,s,\gamma,\eta,\tau)\)，满足 \(\eta\le\gamma\)、\(\tau\le s\)，**不依赖 \(\epsilon\)**。
39	- \(\mathcal C^{\rm const}_\theta:=\{\mathrm{SPLALM}_{\theta,\alpha,\beta}:(\alpha,\beta)\in[0,1]^2\}\)，即 Algorithm `alg:ddlalm` 取 \(s_k\equiv s,\ \eta_k\equiv\eta,\ \tau_k\equiv\tau,\ \alpha_k\equiv\alpha,\ \beta_k\equiv\beta\)，更新式引用 `eq:explicit-updates`，不要重写成别的形式。
40	- 写明：\((\alpha,\beta)\) 可依赖 \(\epsilon,\Delta,\theta,\mathbf C\)，但在实例之前选定。
41	- Remark：\(\beta=1\) 给出经典线性化 ALM 的乘子更新（引用 `eq:inexact-center-multiplier-update`）；\(\alpha=0\) 或 \(\beta=0\) 是端点，仍属于族；`thm:main` 的时变参数与递增 \(s_k\) 不在此族中。
42	
43	### Definition 4（复杂度）`\label{def:family-complexity}`
44	\[
45	\mathfrak T^{\rm const}_\theta(\epsilon;\Delta,\mathbf C):=\inf_{(\alpha,\beta)\in[0,1]^2}\ \sup_{I\in\mathcal I(\mathbf C,\Delta)}\ T_\epsilon(\mathrm{SPLALM}_{\theta,\alpha,\beta};I).
46	\]
47	- Remark：格式对照 Carmon et al. 式 (7) 与 Tian–So。明确说明这是**算法族复杂度**，不是 oracle 复杂度：下界只说明该族内没有常数中心步长能更快，不说明其他一阶方法不能更快（Pan–Zheng–Li 2609.14235 与 Li–Pan 的 oracle 不含 prox，不可移用）。
48	
49	## 3. 约束
50	- 记号与稿件一致：粗体向量用已有宏；新宏只在本文件内定义，并在报告中列出。
51	- 不写主定理、不写构造与证明；只在小节末尾用一句话预告主定理的形式：\(\mathfrak T^{\rm const}_\theta(\epsilon;\Delta,\mathbf C)\ge c\,\Delta\epsilon^{-4}/(\gamma K_\theta)\)，\(\epsilon<\epsilon_\theta(\Delta)\)，常数留给 `\ref{thm:lower-bound}`（标签先占位）。
52	- 新引用加入 `tools/refer.bib` 前核对卷号页码；无法核对的条目加 `% TODO verify` 注释。不要改动已有 bib 条目。

54	## 4. 报告（回复我）
55	1. 新文件路径与编译结果（含 warning）。
56	2. 每个定义各借鉴了哪篇文献的哪一处。

58	4. 你认为定义与 `PROJECT_STATUS.md` 第 3 节定理量词不一致的地方。

## 结论

**方向基本对，但有四处不准确。** 当前下界确实只针对一个固定递推（SPLALM 四步，参数 θ 固定，常数 (α,β)），这一点说对了。需要修正的是：实例类并非原样保留、"成员"关系未证、变步长不宜当作越过方式、"结构 1–3 可直接推广"过于乐观。

Codex 这一步的状态：

- `~/.codex/config.toml` 第 6 行默认模型已经是 `gpt-6-astra`。403 来自我手动传入的 `gpt-5.4`。
- 我已把 `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` 第 7 行改成 `reviewer_model: gpt-6-astra`。
- `novelty-check/SKILL.md` 第 14 行仍写 `gpt-5.5`，其他 skill 里可能也有 `gpt-5.x`，我没有改。
- 你中断了第二次 Codex 调用，所以下面的新颖性判断只有我一个模型的意见。

## 逐条判断

| 他的说法 | 判断 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 下界只适用于 SPLALM 四步加常数 (α,β) | 对 | [Definition 3](astra-lowerbound-definitions-prompt.md:37) 的 Remark 已写明 `thm:main` 的时变参数与递增 $s_k$ 不在族内 |
| 先下界后算法，所以不能绑定 SPLALM | 部分对 | [Li 等 2602.14185](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14185) 的下界就是对具名算法在参数条件下陈述的（"存在函数与初值使该算法需要……"）。绑定具名算法本身没有问题，问题出在叙事：越过方式必须能归因 |
| 实例类与算法无关，原样保留 | **不准确** | [Definition 1](astra-lowerbound-definitions-prompt.md:27) 含 $w^0=(x^0,z^0,\lambda^0,\mu^0)$，即 SPLALM 全部四个变量的初值。实例在 $(\theta,\alpha,\beta)$ 之后选取，$\kappa$ 按迭代矩阵调到精确对消。只有 $(f,A,h,\mathbf C,\Delta)$ 部分与算法无关 |
| SPLALM、smoothed GDA、DSGDA 都是类成员 | **未证** | Smoothed GDA 对应 $s=\infty$，不在 $\tau\le s$、$\epsilon<\epsilon_\theta$ 的有限 $s$ 范围内。DS-GDA 是约束 minimax 方法，没有增广项 $\rho$。成员关系需要逐个证明 |
| 新算法靠变步长、外推、双循环越过 | **漏了最便宜的越过方式** | 递增 $s_k$ 保持同一四步递推，边界在参数调度。变步长作为越过方式还有风险，见下 |
| 只依赖结构 1–3 的步骤可直接推广 | **过乐观** | 快分支靠 $\kappa$ 与耦合阻尼精确对消。可迁移的是技术（时不变线性递推加单位模特征值），实例每换一个模板要重算迭代矩阵 |
| 不改成 oracle 下界 | 对，已核实 | [Pan–Zheng–Li 2609.14235](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14235) 给出 NC-C 的 $\Omega(\epsilon^{-3})$ 加匹配的 Tracked-FOAM。[Wu–Gu–Yang 2609.14233](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14233) 在 zero-respecting 类上同阶。$\epsilon^{-4}$ 的 oracle 下界与已知上界矛盾 |

关于变步长：研究记录 [1.8 节](../notes/ddlalm-research-questions.md) 已指出，若下界只覆盖常数步长，而 `thm:main` 同时改了 $s$ 和步长类型，对照就不干净。所以预定时变步长 $\Pi_{\rm pre}$ 应放进下界类，把 $s$ 留作唯一变量。他的建议在这一点上与项目自己的目标相反。

## 建议的类定义

按"时不变性"分层，边界由参数调度划定：

| 层级 | 内容 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | θ 固定，$(\alpha,\beta)$ 常数 | 已证 |
| L2 | θ 固定，$(\alpha_k,\beta_k)$ 预定时变 | 待证，是干净分离的前提 |
| L3 | $s_k$ 等随迭代变化 | `thm:main` 在此层，达到 $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ |

新算法落在哪一层，论文论点就是什么：

- **选 s 增长**：已有结果，边界清楚。
- **选 s 固定的外推或加速中心**：先检验，在同一族实例上算扩展后迭代矩阵的谱半径，看能否仍被钉在单位圆上。能钉住，说明它在 L1 之内，不构成越过。钉不住，才是真正的结构性越过。这个检验与你们验证 SPLALM 的数值核对同类，成本低。

## 文献（摘要级核实，Zotero 本次不可用）

| 论文 | 内容 | 与我们的关系 |
|---|---|---|
| [2602.14185](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14185) Li–Nagarajan–Pan–Zhang | 光滑化加速 GS 与 OS，对偶扰动只加速 GS；对 PGDA、PSGDA、SGDA 的算法特定下界，PSGDA 取 $r_x=\Theta(\ell)$ 常数 | 形式与"互补"叙事的最近先例。**回答你之前的 $r_x$ 问题：最优速率里 $r_x$ 是常数，耦合 $\epsilon$ 的是对偶扰动** |
| [2607.08954](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08954) Zhu–Li | 单环 smoothed prox-linear ALM，复合约束，带对偶正则 $O(K^{-1/3})$，无下界 | 同问题族，需要精读上界部分 |
| [2502.17770](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17770) Liu–Lin–Xu | 线性约束复合非凸的 oracle 下界 | 对象不同（oracle 类） |
| [2608.19847](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19847) | 固定罚线性化 ALM，经典乘子，正则性驱动 | 来自搜索结果标题，未精读 |
| 2207.06304、2406.17107（PPALA） | 来自项目笔记 | 本次未重新核对，标 UNVERIFIED |

## 新颖性（单模型判断，检索量有限，"没找到"不等于"没有"）

| 主张 | 评级 | 最近先例与审稿人会怎么说 |
|---|---|---|
| (a) 移动中心 ALM 单环、自身 KKT 证书、非线性 A 的固定参数 $\Omega(\epsilon^{-4})$ | 中高 | 本次检索未发现同对象下界。形式上有 2602.14185 先例，审稿人会说"算法特定的紧性，不是必要性" |
| (b) 至少一个参数必须与 $\epsilon$ 耦合 | 低到中 | 2602.14185 已建立"对偶扰动耦合 ε 才改善 GS 速率"。目前定理只覆盖 θ 全固定，"s 必须 Ω(1/ε)"尚待证 $\epsilon_\theta$ 对 $s$ 一致 |
| (c) $s_k\sim k^{1/3}$ 实现 $s\sim1/\epsilon$ 而无需预知 $\epsilon$ | 低到中 | 递增罚是常规做法，笔记里 Hu–Deng 的单环方法也有罚增长。新意在 $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ 加上与下界配对说明增长必要 |

**总体 6/10，谨慎推进。** 定位建议写成"时不变单环更新在精度无关的正则化下无法超过 $\epsilon^{-4}$，打破时不变性（$s_k$ 增长）可达 $\epsilon^{-3}$"，不要写成"首个 ALM 下界"。

## 下一步

建议先做外推中心变体的谱半径检验，再据结果决定论文的越过方式是 $s_k$ 增长还是结构改动。是否现在跑？跑之前需要你确认变体的更新式（Güler/He–Yuan 型外推，还是别的）。

**要点**：他的结论在方向上成立，但类的边界应由参数调度而非步骤结构划定，实例类含 SPLALM 初值，成员关系需逐个证明。

Sources: [2602.14185](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14185) · [2609.14235](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14235) · [2609.14233](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14233) · [2502.17770](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17770) · [2607.08954](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08954) · [2608.19847](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.19847)

以及
\[ B_\theta:= \min\left\{ 1,\, \frac1{4\sqrt{K_\theta}},\, \frac1{4\sqrt{C_{\rm tr}\eta s}},\, \frac1{8C_{\rm res}},\, \frac1{2(2C_{\rm du}+5\rho/4)},\, \frac1{8\sqrt{\rho+s}} \right\}. \tag{2} \]

定理。 对任意预先固定的 \(\Delta>0\)、任意
\[ 0<\epsilon<\epsilon_\theta(\Delta), \qquad \alpha_\epsilon<\alpha\le1,\qquad 0\le\beta\le1, \]

以下证明大 \(\alpha\) 分支。小 \(\alpha\) 分支只在最后合并，不重新证明。

\[ \boxed{\max\{X,|\Lambda|\}=\frac13.} \tag{11} \]
这里的复数用于表示二维实向量。下文使用
\[ \mathcal V(c):=(\Re c,\Im c). \]

上述参数满足

\[ a_{\rm p}:=\frac{\nu(W-1)}{\eta\alpha}, \qquad a_{\rm d}:=\frac{\xi}{\eta}. \]

3. 精确满足标准初始化的谱分解
在局部二次区域和 \(y=0\) 分支内，平移后的四变量递推矩阵为
\[ \mathbb M= \begin{pmatrix} m&-\eta b&\chi&0\\ \tau bm&1-d-\eta\tau b^2&\tau b\chi&d\\ \alpha m&-\alpha\eta b&1-\alpha+\alpha\chi&0\\ \beta\tau bm&\beta(1-d-\eta\tau b^2)& \beta\tau b\chi&1-\beta+\beta d \end{pmatrix}, \qquad m:=1+\eta a-\chi. \tag{15} \]
以下构造一个衰减分量，使初始时刻满足 \(x=z\)、\(\lambda=\mu\)。
定义
\[ r_x:= -\frac{(W-1)u/(u+\alpha)+\xi\zeta/(u+V)} {W+\xi}\,X, \tag{16} \]\[ h_x:= \xi\left[(1-\alpha)r_x+ (V-\alpha)\frac{\zeta}{u+V}X\right], \qquad v_x:=-Dr_x+h_x, \tag{17} \]
以及
\[ \begin{aligned} r_\lambda &:=\frac{\chi(X-Z)+\eta a r_x-v_x}{\eta b},\\ r_z&:=X-Z+r_x,\\ r_\mu&:=\Lambda-M+r_\lambda. \end{aligned} \tag{18} \]
设
\[ \mathbf v:=(X,\Lambda,Z,M)^\top, \qquad \mathbf r:=(r_x,r_\lambda,r_z,r_\mu)^\top. \]
引理 2：旋转分量与衰减分量的精确分解
令
\[ \vartheta:=(1-V)\xi, \qquad Q_{\rm f}(t):= (t-1+D)(t-1+V)-\vartheta(t-1+\alpha). \tag{19} \]
则
\[ \mathbb M\mathbf v=\zeta\mathbf v, \qquad Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0, \tag{20} \]
且
\[ \boxed{ \mathbf v+\mathbf r=(P_0,Q_0,P_0,Q_0)^\top, \qquad P_0:=X+r_x,\quad Q_0:=\Lambda+r_\lambda. } \tag{21} \]
证明。 消去两个中心分量后，\(\mathbb M\) 的特征多项式，以 \(v=t-1\) 表示，为
\[ \begin{aligned} \mathcal Q(v) ={}&v^2(v+U)(v+V) -\eta a\,v(v+\alpha)(v+V)\\ &+\eta\tau b^2(v+1)(v+\alpha)(v+\beta). \end{aligned} \]
代入式 (7)，整理得
\[ \boxed{ \mathcal Q(v) =(v^2+\nu v+\nu) \left[(v+D)(v+V)-\vartheta(v+\alpha)\right]. } \tag{22} \]
这里可使用的三个消去关系是
\[ \eta a=\frac{\nu(W-1)}{\alpha}+\xi,\quad \eta\tau b^2=\nu W+V\xi,\quad U-\alpha W=\frac{(1-\alpha)\nu(W-1)}{\alpha}. \]
因为 \(u^2+\nu u+\nu=0\)，式 (9)–(10) 随即给出
\(\mathbb M\mathbf v=\zeta\mathbf v\)。
下面验证衰减分量。先在两个快根 \(t_1,t_2\) 不同、所用分母非零的情形推导。对应特征向量可取
\[ \mathbf v(t)= \left( 1,\, \frac{\tau bt(t-1+\beta)}{(t-1)(t-1+V)},\, \frac{\alpha t}{t-1+\alpha},\, \frac{\beta t}{t-1+\beta} \frac{\tau bt(t-1+\beta)}{(t-1)(t-1+V)} \right)^\top. \]
设快分量为 \(c_1\mathbf v(t_1)+c_2\mathbf v(t_2)\)。它与旋转分量相加后满足两组中心同步条件，当且仅当
\[ \sum_{j=1}^2c_j\frac{t_j-1}{t_j-1+\alpha} =-\frac{u}{u+\alpha}X, \qquad \sum_{j=1}^2c_j\frac{t_j}{t_j-1+V} =-\frac{\zeta}{u+V}X. \tag{23} \]
记
\[ S_0=c_1+c_2,\qquad S_1=(t_1-1)c_1+(t_2-1)c_2. \]
快根的 \(v=t-1\) 满足
\[ v^2+C_{\rm f}v+D_{\rm f}=0, \quad C_{\rm f}=D+V-\vartheta,\quad D_{\rm f}=DV-\alpha\vartheta. \]
在这些根上，
\[ \frac{v}{v+\alpha} =\frac{D_{\rm f}+\alpha v} {\alpha^2-C_{\rm f}\alpha+D_{\rm f}}, \]\[ \frac{v+1}{v+V} =\frac{D_{\rm f}-C_{\rm f}+V-(1-V)v} {V^2-C_{\rm f}V+D_{\rm f}}. \]
两处分母分别为
\[ \alpha(W-1)(V-\alpha), \qquad \vartheta(V-\alpha). \]
将它们代入式 (23) 并解这两个线性方程，得到
\[ S_0=r_x,\qquad S_1=v_x, \]
其中右端正是式 (16)–(17)。
第一步原始递推再给出其对偶分量：
\[ \eta b r_\lambda =\chi(X-Z)+\eta a r_x-v_x. \]
两个中心分量由同步条件确定，即式 (18)。因此该快分量就是 \(\mathbf r\)，且
\(Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0\)。
最终公式 (16)–(18) 的分母在本任务的参数范围内均不为零，且连续。因此上述矩阵恒等式延伸到快根重合、\(\alpha=1\)、\(\beta=1\)、\(d=1\) 等情形；这里延伸的是已经得到的有限维矩阵恒等式，不需要假定这些端点仍有一组不同的快特征向量。式 (21) 则由式 (18) 逐分量成立。证毕。
引理 3：从 \(k=0\) 开始的瞬态控制
定义
\[ \mathbf r^k:=\mathbb M^k\mathbf r, \]
以 \(x_{\rm f}^k,\lambda_{\rm f}^k,z_{\rm f}^k,\mu_{\rm f}^k\) 表示其分量。则
\[ \mathbf r^k\longrightarrow0, \tag{24} \]
并且对所有 \(k\ge0\)，
\[ \boxed{ |x_{\rm f}^k|\le\frac X4, \qquad |\lambda_{\rm f}^k|,\ |\mu_{\rm f}^k| \le C_{\rm du}bX. } \tag{25} \]
此外，
\[ \sum_{k=0}^\infty|x_{\rm f}^k|\le\frac X\chi. \tag{26} \]
证明。 令
\[ r_{\rm p}:=1-D,\qquad r_{\rm d}:=1-V. \]
二者均在 \([0,1)\) 内。由式 (12) 和常数选择，
\[ \frac{2\vartheta}{DV}\le\frac14. \tag{27} \]
若 \(|t|\ge1\)，则
\[ |(t-r_{\rm p})(t-r_{\rm d})| \ge |t|^2DV, \qquad |\vartheta(t-1+\alpha)|\le2\vartheta|t|. \]
因此 \(Q_{\rm f}\) 在 \(|t|\ge1\) 上没有零点。结合
\(Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0\)，所有快分量都趋于零。
原始快分量满足
\[ \begin{aligned} x_{\rm f}^{k+2} -(r_{\rm p}+r_{\rm d})x_{\rm f}^{k+1} +r_{\rm p}r_{\rm d}x_{\rm f}^{k} = \vartheta\left[x_{\rm f}^{k+1}-(1-\alpha)x_{\rm f}^{k}\right], \end{aligned} \tag{28} \]
初值为
\[ x_{\rm f}^0=r_x,\qquad x_{\rm f}^1-r_{\rm p}x_{\rm f}^0=h_x. \]
基础递推的卷积核
\[ G_j=\sum_{i=0}^j r_{\rm p}^{\,j-i}r_{\rm d}^{\,i} \]
非负，且
\[ \sum_{j=0}^\infty G_j=\frac1{DV}. \]
从式 (16)–(17) 可得
\[ |r_x|\le\left(\frac18+\frac{\xi}{d}\right)X, \qquad |h_x|\le\xi(1+d^{-1})X. \]
故
\[ |r_x|+\frac{|h_x|}{DV} \le \left(\frac18+\xi C_{\rm tr}\right)X \le\frac{3X}{16}. \]
对式 (28) 使用上述卷积核，先在有限前缀上取最大值，再用式 (27) 移项，得到
\[ \sup_k|x_{\rm f}^k| \le \frac{|r_x|+|h_x|/(DV)} {1-2\vartheta/(DV)} \le\frac X4. \]
同样对绝对值求和，
\[ \sum_k|x_{\rm f}^k| \le \frac{|r_x|/D+|h_x|/(DV)} {1-2\vartheta/(DV)} \le \left(\frac1{2\chi}+\frac1{12}\right)X \le\frac X\chi. \]
为控制对偶快分量，定义
\[ e^k:=\lambda_{\rm f}^k-\mu_{\rm f}^k, \qquad v^k:=\frac{\beta(1-d)\lambda_{\rm f}^k+d\mu_{\rm f}^k}{V}. \]
由实际对偶、对偶中心更新，
\[ e^{k+1} =(1-V)e^k+\tau b(1-\beta)x_{\rm f}^{k+1}, \tag{29} \]\[ v^{k+1}=v^k+\frac{\tau b\beta}{V}x_{\rm f}^{k+1}. \tag{30} \]
初始中心差满足
\[ e^0=-(\Lambda-M) =-\frac{\tau b(1-\beta)\zeta}{u+V}X. \]
因此，由 \(\tau/V\le s\) 和原始快分量界，
\[ |e^k|\le\frac54sbX. \]
又因为 \(v^k\to0\)，式 (30) 可从未来求和：
\[ v^k=-\frac{\tau b\beta}{V} \sum_{j=k+1}^\infty x_{\rm f}^j, \]
故
\[ |v^k|\le\frac{\tau}{\chi}bX. \]
最后使用
\[ \lambda_{\rm f}^k=v^k+\frac dV e^k, \qquad \mu_{\rm f}^k =v^k-\frac{\beta(1-d)}V e^k, \]
即得式 (25)。证毕。
4. 新实例、全局假设与全部证书
4.1 显式实例
由式 (21)，定义问题数据中的两个固定向量
\[ x_c:=-\mathcal V(P_0), \qquad \lambda_c:=-\mathcal V(Q_0), \qquad R_*:=\frac54X. \tag{31} \]
取
\[ \boxed{ A(x)=b(x-x_c),\qquad h(y)=\|y\|_2, } \tag{32} \]
以及
\[ \boxed{ f(x) =\psi_{\kappa,R_*}(\|x-x_c\|) -b\langle\lambda_c,x-x_c\rangle, } \tag{33} \]
其中
\[ \psi_{\kappa,R}(r)= \begin{cases} -\dfrac{\kappa}{2}r^2,&0\le r\le R,\\[1mm] \dfrac{\kappa}{2}(r-2R)^2-\kappa R^2, &R\le r\le3R,\\[1mm] \kappa R(r-3R)-\dfrac{\kappa}{2}R^2, &r\ge3R. \end{cases} \tag{34} \]
这里选择的是问题中的 \(x_c,\lambda_c\)，不是算法初值。算法初值仍然是四个零向量。
4.2 全局假设和间隙预算
三段函数在接点处的函数值和一阶导数匹配。径向 Hessian 的特征值为
\(\psi''(r)\) 和 \(\psi'(r)/r\)，各分段上绝对值均不超过 \(\kappa\)。因此
\[ \operatorname{Lip}(\nabla f)\le\kappa, \qquad \sup_x\|\nabla f(x)\| \le\kappa R_*+b\|\lambda_c\|. \]
由引理 3，
\[ \|\lambda_c\| \le|\Lambda|+C_{\rm du}bX \le\frac12, \qquad R_*\le\frac5{12}. \]
所以
\[ L_f\le\frac1{32}<1,\qquad G_f\le\frac5{384}+\frac12<1. \]
同时 \(L_A=0\)、\(G_A=b\le1\)、\(L_h=1\)，满足附件要求的全局光滑性和 Lipschitz 条件。 main
当 \(r=\|x-x_c\|\ge3R_*\) 时，
\[ F(x)\ge \left[\kappa R_*+b(1-\|\lambda_c\|)\right]r -\frac72\kappa R_*^2. \]
右端趋于 \(+\infty\)，故 \(F\) 也满足 Assumption 1。
因为
\[ \inf_r\psi_{\kappa,R_*}(r)=-\kappa R_*^2, \]
且
\[ b\|x-x_c\|-b\langle\lambda_c,x-x_c\rangle\ge0, \]
有 \(\inf F\ge-\kappa R_*^2\)。又有 \(\|P_0\|\le R_*\)，故
\[ \begin{aligned} F(0)-\inf F &\le \frac32bR_*+\kappa R_*^2\\ &\le \frac58b+\frac{25}{144}C_{\rm gap}b^2\\ &\le \boxed{5\epsilon+\frac{100}{9}C_{\rm gap}\epsilon^2} \le\Delta. \end{aligned} \tag{35} \]
没有引入段，因此也没有额外的引入段间隙消耗。
4.3 从零出发的实际轨迹
定义候选误差轨迹
\[ \begin{pmatrix} p^k\\ \ell^k\\ \widehat z^k\\ \widehat\mu^k \end{pmatrix} := \zeta^k\mathbf v+\mathbf r^k, \tag{36} \]
并将复数分量识别为二维实向量。实际变量取
\[ x^k=x_c+\mathcal V(p^k),\quad z^k=x_c+\mathcal V(\widehat z^k), \]\[ \lambda^k=\lambda_c+\mathcal V(\ell^k),\quad \mu^k=\lambda_c+\mathcal V(\widehat\mu^k). \]
由式 (21)、(31)，这四个变量在 \(k=0\) 时全部等于零。
引理 3 给出
\[ \frac34X\le|p^k|\le\frac54X=R_*. \tag{37} \]
因此每次梯度计算都满足
\[ \nabla f(x^k)=-\kappa\mathcal V(p^k)-b\lambda_c. \]
另一方面，对前原始步和后原始步两种 prox 输入，都有
\[ \begin{aligned} \|\lambda^k+\rho A(x^j)\| &\le 2|\Lambda|+2C_{\rm du}bX+\frac54\rho bX\\ &\le \frac13\left[2+b(2C_{\rm du}+5\rho/4)\right] \le\frac56<1, \end{aligned} \qquad j=k,\ k+1. \tag{38} \]
对于 \(h(y)=\|y\|_2\)，式 (38) 精确意味着这两次 prox 输出都是 \(0\)。
于是，候选轨迹在每一步都使用预期的二次梯度和 \(y=0\) 分支，四步更新恰好等于矩阵 (15)。由初值和递推的唯一性，式 (36) 就是实际轨迹。
这也给出了全程有界性：\(x^k,z^k\) 的范数不超过 \(5/6\)，\(\lambda^k,\mu^k\) 的范数也不超过 \(5/6\)。
4.4 原点不是原问题的驻点
这不是把原点放在另一个精确 KKT 点上。
由式 (16)–(18)，利用
\[ \bar u=-u/\zeta,\qquad u^2+\nu u+\nu=0 \]
消去快分量，得到
\[ \begin{aligned} \frac{\eta bQ_0}{P_0} &= \frac{\bar u(\bar u+U)}{\bar u+\alpha} +\eta\tau b^2\frac{\bar u+\beta}{\bar u+V}\\ &= \eta a-\eta\tau b^2 \frac{\bar u+\beta}{\bar u(\bar u+V)}. \end{aligned} \]
因此
\[ \frac{Q_0}{P_0} =\frac ab-\overline{\frac L\zeta}. \tag{39} \]
记 \(\omega=\Im\zeta>0\)。分式分解给出
\[ \Im\frac L\zeta = -\tau b\omega \left[ \frac{\beta}{V\nu} +\frac{V-\beta}{VH} \right]<0. \]
所以 \(P_0,Q_0\) 不共线，且由式 (37)，\(P_0\ne0\)。
原点处 \(A(0)=b\mathcal V(P_0)\ne0\)，因此 \(F\) 可微，并有
\[ \nabla F(0) = \left(-\kappa+\frac b{|P_0|}\right)\mathcal V(P_0) +b\mathcal V(Q_0)\ne0. \tag{40} \]
4.5 对所有 \(k\) 的证书下界
因为 \(y^{k+1}=0\)，残差为
\[ R_k= \max\left\{ |-ap^{k+1}+b\ell^k|, \ b|p^{k+1}| \right\}. \tag{41} \]
可行性部分由式 (37) 给出
\[ b|p^{k+1}|\ge\frac34bX. \tag{42} \]
站立性部分由引理 1、3 给出
\[ \begin{aligned} |-ap^{k+1}+b\ell^k| &\ge b|\Lambda|-C_{\rm du}b^2X-\frac54aX\\ &\ge \frac{27}{32}b|\Lambda|-C_{\rm res}b^2X. \end{aligned} \tag{43} \]
若 \(|\Lambda|\ge X\)，利用 \(bC_{\rm res}\le1/8\)，式 (43) 至少为
\[ \frac{23}{32}b|\Lambda|\ge\frac12b|\Lambda|. \]
若 \(X\ge|\Lambda|\)，则使用式 (42)。两种情况合并，
\[ \boxed{ R_k\ge \frac b2\max\{X,|\Lambda|\} =\frac b6 \ge\frac76\epsilon>\epsilon, \qquad k\ge0. } \tag{44} \]
这个估计包含 \(k=0\) 和全部瞬态阶段，不需要等待快模态衰减。渐近阶段则有
\[ \mathbf r^k\to0,\qquad \max\{|\zeta^kX|,|\zeta^k\Lambda|\}=\frac13. \]
因此，不衰减模态的联合振幅具有与 \(\alpha,\beta,\epsilon\) 无关的下界。
至此，\(\beta>0\) 的整个大 \(\alpha\) 区域已经完成。
5. \(\beta=0\)：原偏差例子的早期界不成立，但有替代实例
先回答任务 (f)。对
\[ f(x)=-cx,\qquad A(x)=x,\qquad h(y)=L|y|, \]
从零出发，只要 \(\rho\eta c<L\)，第一张证书满足
\[ R_0=c\max\{|1-\rho\eta|,\eta\}. \]
它不一定大于 \(c/(\rho+s)\)。例如
\[ \rho=s=\frac14,\quad \gamma=\frac12,\quad \eta=\frac18,\quad \tau=\frac1{100},\quad L=1,\quad c=\frac14 \]
给出
\[ R_0=\frac{31}{32}c < \frac{c}{\rho+s}=2c. \]
所以不能把驻点偏差直接用于所有早期证书。
下面的替代构造对全部 \(\alpha\in[0,1]\) 有效。
引理 4：零初始化下的永久可行性偏差
令
\[ \ell_0:=\min\{1,(2\eta)^{-1}\},\qquad d_0:=\min\{1,\sqrt\Delta\}, \]\[ q_h:=2s+1,\qquad Q:=\rho+q_h,\qquad a_0:=\frac{4\epsilon(Q+s)}{q_h}. \]
取一维实例
\[ f(x)=\ell_0\left(\sqrt{1+(x-d_0)^2}-1\right), \qquad A(x)\equiv a_0, \tag{45} \]\[ h(y)= \begin{cases} \dfrac{q_h}{2}y^2,&|y|\le q_h^{-1},\\[1mm] |y|-\dfrac1{2q_h},&|y|\ge q_h^{-1}. \end{cases} \tag{46} \]

\[ R_k>2\epsilon\qquad\text{对所有 }k\ge0. \tag{47} \]
证明。 这些函数满足
\[ L_f,G_f\le1,\qquad L_A=G_A=0,\qquad L_h=1. \]
由于 \(A\) 为常数，
\[ F(0)-\inf F =\ell_0\left(\sqrt{1+d_0^2}-1\right) \le\Delta/2. \]
\(f\) 向无穷远增长，因此 \(F\) 水平集有界；同时 \(f'(0)\ne0\)，原点不是驻点。
现在验证 prox 分支和对偶轨迹。令
\[ r_\theta:=1-\frac{\tau}{s}-\frac{\tau}{Q}, \qquad \lambda_*:=\frac{s q_h a_0}{Q+s}. \]
因为 \(Q>2s\) 且 \(\tau\le s\)，
\[ -\frac{s}{Q}\le r_\theta<1,\qquad |r_\theta|<1. \]
候选对偶轨迹为
\[ \lambda^k=\lambda_*(1-r_\theta^k),\qquad \mu^k=0. \tag{48} \]
它满足
\[ 0\le\lambda^k \le\lambda_*\left(1+\frac sQ\right) =\frac{s q_h a_0}{Q} <\frac12q_h a_0. \]
式 (3) 保证 \(q_h a_0\le1/4\)。因此
\[ y^{k+1}=\frac{\rho a_0+\lambda^k}{Q} \in[0,a_0]\subset[0,q_h^{-1}], \]
确实位于 \(h\) 的二次分支。这证明式 (48) 是实际对偶递推，而非仅在线性分支内形式推导的解。
可行性残差于是等于
\[ \begin{aligned} A(x^{k+1})-y^{k+1} &=\frac{q_h a_0-\lambda^k}{Q}\\ &=\frac{q_h a_0}{Q+s} \left(1+\frac sQ r_\theta^k\right)\\ &=4\epsilon\left(1+\frac sQ r_\theta^k\right) >2\epsilon. \end{aligned} \]
这已经证明式 (47)，与原始变量的进展无关。
原始轨迹也有界。由于 \(J_A=0\)，原始两步对
\[ P(x,z):=f(x)+\frac{(x-z)^2}{2\gamma} \]

\[ \eta(\ell_0+1/\gamma)\le\frac32. \]

\[ f(x^k)\le P(x^k,z^k)\le f(0), \]
从而 \(x^k\in[0,2d_0]\)；由中心凸组合更新，\(z^k\) 也在这个区间。证毕。
6. 端点、交界与最终结论
\(\beta=1\) 已包含在第 2–4 节中。此时
\[ V=1,\qquad \xi=0,\qquad M=\Lambda,\qquad r_\mu=r_\lambda. \]
所以从全零初值开始始终有 \(\mu^k=\lambda^k\)，没有借用非零对偶中心差。快多项式退化为
\[ Q_{\rm f}(t)=t(t-1+\alpha W), \]
上述证明仍成立。
\(\alpha=1\) 时 \(W=1\)，式 (16)–(18) 仍有定义；引理 2–3 的矩阵恒等式和瞬态估计均覆盖该端点。
\(\beta=0\) 由引理 4 覆盖，且对所有 \(\alpha\) 有效。
分界点没有改变：大分支处理
\[ \alpha>\alpha_\epsilon, \]
已知的平台分支处理
\[ 0<\alpha\le\alpha_\epsilon. \]
在后一区域，使用你列为已知的估计，
\[ T_\epsilon \ge\frac{\Delta}{32\gamma\alpha\epsilon^2} \ge\frac{\Delta}{32768\gamma K_\theta}\epsilon^{-4}. \]
\(\alpha=0\) 则由原平台实例给出 \(T_\epsilon=+\infty\)。因此式 (5) 的全部步长量词闭合。
最终机制不是“先把零初值送入原来的特制轨道”。 新问题从零出发时，就具有一个振幅固定的单位模分量；为满足标准初始化而增加的快分量满足
\[ |x_{\rm f}^k|\le X/4,\qquad |\lambda_{\rm f}^k|,|\mu_{\rm f}^k|\le C_{\rm du}bX, \]

1. 定理与统一常数
固定
\[ \theta=(\rho,s,\gamma,\eta,\tau)>0, \qquad \eta\le\gamma,\quad \tau\le s, \]
并记
\[ \chi:=\frac{\eta}{\gamma}\in(0,1], \qquad d:=\frac{\tau}{s}\in(0,1], \qquad K_\theta:=\max\{1,4\tau,4\gamma\tau\}. \]
保留原证明的分界点
\[ \boxed{\alpha_\epsilon=1024K_\theta\epsilon^2.} \tag{1} \]
定义只依赖 \(\theta\) 的常数
\[ \begin{aligned} C_{\rm tr} &:=\frac1d+\frac{2(1+d^{-1})}{\chi d},\\ C_{\rm du} &:=\frac{\tau}{\chi}+\frac54s,\\ C_{\rm res} &:=C_{\rm du}+\frac54s,\\ C_{\rm gap} &:=\rho+s+2\gamma, \end{aligned} \]
以及
\[ B_\theta:= \min\left\{ 1,\, \frac1{4\sqrt{K_\theta}},\, \frac1{4\sqrt{C_{\rm tr}\eta s}},\, \frac1{8C_{\rm res}},\, \frac1{2(2C_{\rm du}+5\rho/4)},\, \frac1{8\sqrt{\rho+s}} \right\}. \tag{2} \]
可以取
\[ \boxed{ \epsilon_\theta(\Delta):= \min\left\{ \frac{B_\theta}{8},\, \frac{\Delta}{10},\, \sqrt{\frac{9\Delta}{200C_{\rm gap}}},\, \frac1{16(\rho+3s+1)},\, \frac{\sqrt{\Delta}}2,\, \sqrt{\frac{\Delta}{32\gamma}} \right\}. } \tag{3} \]
定理。 对任意预先固定的 \(\Delta>0\)、任意
\[ 0<\epsilon<\epsilon_\theta(\Delta), \qquad \alpha_\epsilon<\alpha\le1,\qquad 0\le\beta\le1, \]
存在至多二维的实例 \((f,A,h)\)，满足 Assumptions 1–3、统一常数
\[ (L_f,G_f,L_A,G_A,L_h)\le(1,1,0,1,1), \qquad F(0)-\inf F\le\Delta, \]
使得从
\[ x^0=z^0=\lambda^0=\mu^0=0 \]
出发，有
\[ R_k>\epsilon\qquad\text{对所有 }k\ge0. \tag{4} \]
其中，\(\beta>0\) 时可保证 \(R_k\ge7\epsilon/6\)，\(\beta=0\) 时可保证 \(R_k>2\epsilon\)。
因而，结合已经完成的小 \(\alpha\) 分支，标准初始化版本满足
\[ \boxed{ \inf_{(\alpha,\beta)\in[0,1]^2} \sup_{I\in\mathcal I_0(\mathbf C_0,\Delta)} T_\epsilon(\theta,\alpha,\beta;I) \ge \frac{\Delta}{32768\gamma K_\theta}\epsilon^{-4}, } \tag{5} \]
这里 \(\mathcal I_0\) 表示四个初值均固定为零的实例类，\(\mathbf C_0=(1,1,0,1,1)\)。
以下证明大 \(\alpha\) 分支。小 \(\alpha\) 分支只在最后合并，不重新证明。
2. \(\beta>0\)：参数和旋转模态
以下固定
\[ \alpha>\alpha_\epsilon,\qquad 0<\beta\le1. \]
取参考耦合尺度
\[ b_\epsilon:=8\epsilon, \]
并定义
\[ U:=\alpha+\chi(1-\alpha), \qquad V:=\beta+d(1-\beta), \qquad \nu:=\frac{\eta\tau b_\epsilon^2\alpha\beta}{UV}. \tag{6} \]
再令
\[ \begin{aligned} E&:=\alpha^2+(1-\alpha)\nu,\\ H&:=V^2+(1-V)\nu,\\ J&:=\beta V+(1-V)\nu,\\ W&:=1+\frac{\chi\alpha(1-\alpha)}{E}. \end{aligned} \]
实际耦合系数、辅助量和曲率取为
\[ \boxed{ b^2:=\frac{\nu WH}{\eta\tau J}, \qquad \xi:=\frac{\eta\tau b^2(V-\beta)}{H}, \qquad a:=\frac{\nu(W-1)}{\eta\alpha}+\frac{\xi}{\eta}, \qquad \kappa:=\rho b^2+a. } \tag{7} \]
定义单位模复数
\[ \zeta:=1-\frac{\nu}{2} +i\sqrt{\nu-\frac{\nu^2}{4}}, \qquad u:=\zeta-1. \tag{8} \]
下面的估计保证 \(0<\nu<4\)，故 \(|\zeta|=1\) 且 \(\Im\zeta>0\)。
令
\[ L:=\frac{\tau b\,\zeta(u+\beta)}{u(u+V)}, \qquad X:=\frac{1}{3\max\{1,|L|\}}, \qquad \Lambda:=LX, \tag{9} \]
以及
\[ Z:=\frac{\alpha\zeta}{u+\alpha}X, \qquad M:=\frac{\beta\zeta}{u+\beta}\Lambda. \tag{10} \]
于是
\[ \boxed{\max\{X,|\Lambda|\}=\frac13.} \tag{11} \]
这里的复数用于表示二维实向量。下文使用
\[ \mathcal V(c):=(\Re c,\Im c). \]
引理 1：参数和振幅的统一估计
上述参数满足
\[ \frac{\nu}{\alpha^2}\le\frac1{64}, \qquad 7\epsilon\le b\le8\epsilon, \qquad \frac{\chi}{2}\le D:=\alpha W\le1, \qquad \xi\le\frac1{16C_{\rm tr}}, \tag{12} \]
以及
\[ 0<\kappa\le\frac1{32}, \tag{13} \]\[ aX\le\frac18b|\Lambda|+sb^2X, \qquad \kappa X^2\le C_{\rm gap}b^2\max\{X^2,|\Lambda|^2\}. \tag{14} \]
证明。 因为 \(U\ge\chi\)、\(V\ge\beta\)，由分界条件，
\[ \frac{\nu}{\alpha^2} \le \frac{\gamma\tau b_\epsilon^2}{\alpha} < \frac{\gamma\tau}{16K_\theta} \le\frac1{64}. \]
记 \(\delta=\nu/\alpha^2\)。由 \(W\) 的定义，
\[ D=\alpha+ \frac{\chi(1-\alpha)}{1+(1-\alpha)\delta}, \]
所以
\[ \frac{U}{1+\delta}\le D\le U\le1, \qquad D\ge\chi/2. \]
此外，
\[ \frac{b^2}{b_\epsilon^2} =\frac{\alpha W}{U}\frac{\beta H}{VJ}\le1, \]
因为两项分别不超过 \(1\)。由 \(H\ge V^2\)、\(V-\beta\le V\) 得
\[ \xi\le\frac{\eta\tau b^2}{V}\le\eta s b^2 \le\eta s b_\epsilon^2 \le\frac1{16C_{\rm tr}}. \]
又有
\[ \frac{\beta H}{VJ} =1-\frac{(1-V)\xi}{WV} \ge1-\frac{\xi}{d}\ge\frac{15}{16}. \]
因此
\[ \frac{b^2}{b_\epsilon^2} \ge\frac{64}{65}\frac{15}{16} =\frac{12}{13}>\frac{49}{64}, \]
证明 \(b\ge7\epsilon\)。
令
\[ a_{\rm p}:=\frac{\nu(W-1)}{\eta\alpha}, \qquad a_{\rm d}:=\frac{\xi}{\eta}. \]
由
\[ \eta\tau b^2=\nu W+V\xi \]
可得
\[ a_{\rm p}\le\frac{\tau b^2}{\alpha}, \qquad a_{\rm d}\le sb^2. \]
故
\[ \kappa \le(\rho+s)b^2+\frac{\tau b^2}{\alpha} \le\frac1{64}+\frac1{64} =\frac1{32}. \]
为证明振幅估计，记
\[ E_\beta:=\beta^2+(1-\beta)\nu. \]
则
\[ \frac{|\Lambda|^2}{X^2} =\frac{\tau W E_\beta}{\eta J}. \]
同时
\[ J\le \Re\bigl((u+V)\overline{(u+\beta)}\bigr) \le\sqrt{HE_\beta}, \]
从而 \(J^2\le HE_\beta\)。因此
\[ \frac{a_{\rm p}X}{b|\Lambda|} = \frac{\sqrt{\nu}(W-1)J} {\alpha W\sqrt{HE_\beta}} \le\frac{\sqrt{\nu}}{\alpha}\le\frac18, \]
并且
\[ \frac{a_{\rm p}X^2}{b^2|\Lambda|^2} = \frac{\eta(W-1)J^2}{\alpha W^2HE_\beta} \le\frac{\eta}{\alpha W} \le2\gamma. \]
加上 \(a_{\rm d}\le sb^2\) 和 \(\kappa=\rho b^2+a_{\rm p}+a_{\rm d}\)，即得式 (14)。证毕。
3. 精确满足标准初始化的谱分解
在局部二次区域和 \(y=0\) 分支内，平移后的四变量递推矩阵为
\[ \mathbb M= \begin{pmatrix} m&-\eta b&\chi&0\\ \tau bm&1-d-\eta\tau b^2&\tau b\chi&d\\ \alpha m&-\alpha\eta b&1-\alpha+\alpha\chi&0\\ \beta\tau bm&\beta(1-d-\eta\tau b^2)& \beta\tau b\chi&1-\beta+\beta d \end{pmatrix}, \qquad m:=1+\eta a-\chi. \tag{15} \]
以下构造一个衰减分量，使初始时刻满足 \(x=z\)、\(\lambda=\mu\)。
定义
\[ r_x:= -\frac{(W-1)u/(u+\alpha)+\xi\zeta/(u+V)} {W+\xi}\,X, \tag{16} \]\[ h_x:= \xi\left[(1-\alpha)r_x+ (V-\alpha)\frac{\zeta}{u+V}X\right], \qquad v_x:=-Dr_x+h_x, \tag{17} \]
以及
\[ \begin{aligned} r_\lambda &:=\frac{\chi(X-Z)+\eta a r_x-v_x}{\eta b},\\ r_z&:=X-Z+r_x,\\ r_\mu&:=\Lambda-M+r_\lambda. \end{aligned} \tag{18} \]
设
\[ \mathbf v:=(X,\Lambda,Z,M)^\top, \qquad \mathbf r:=(r_x,r_\lambda,r_z,r_\mu)^\top. \]
引理 2：旋转分量与衰减分量的精确分解
令
\[ \vartheta:=(1-V)\xi, \qquad Q_{\rm f}(t):= (t-1+D)(t-1+V)-\vartheta(t-1+\alpha). \tag{19} \]
则
\[ \mathbb M\mathbf v=\zeta\mathbf v, \qquad Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0, \tag{20} \]
且
\[ \boxed{ \mathbf v+\mathbf r=(P_0,Q_0,P_0,Q_0)^\top, \qquad P_0:=X+r_x,\quad Q_0:=\Lambda+r_\lambda. } \tag{21} \]
证明。 消去两个中心分量后，\(\mathbb M\) 的特征多项式，以 \(v=t-1\) 表示，为
\[ \begin{aligned} \mathcal Q(v) ={}&v^2(v+U)(v+V) -\eta a\,v(v+\alpha)(v+V)\\ &+\eta\tau b^2(v+1)(v+\alpha)(v+\beta). \end{aligned} \]
代入式 (7)，整理得
\[ \boxed{ \mathcal Q(v) =(v^2+\nu v+\nu) \left[(v+D)(v+V)-\vartheta(v+\alpha)\right]. } \tag{22} \]
这里可使用的三个消去关系是
\[ \eta a=\frac{\nu(W-1)}{\alpha}+\xi,\quad \eta\tau b^2=\nu W+V\xi,\quad U-\alpha W=\frac{(1-\alpha)\nu(W-1)}{\alpha}. \]
因为 \(u^2+\nu u+\nu=0\)，式 (9)–(10) 随即给出
\(\mathbb M\mathbf v=\zeta\mathbf v\)。
下面验证衰减分量。先在两个快根 \(t_1,t_2\) 不同、所用分母非零的情形推导。对应特征向量可取
\[ \mathbf v(t)= \left( 1,\, \frac{\tau bt(t-1+\beta)}{(t-1)(t-1+V)},\, \frac{\alpha t}{t-1+\alpha},\, \frac{\beta t}{t-1+\beta} \frac{\tau bt(t-1+\beta)}{(t-1)(t-1+V)} \right)^\top. \]
设快分量为 \(c_1\mathbf v(t_1)+c_2\mathbf v(t_2)\)。它与旋转分量相加后满足两组中心同步条件，当且仅当
\[ \sum_{j=1}^2c_j\frac{t_j-1}{t_j-1+\alpha} =-\frac{u}{u+\alpha}X, \qquad \sum_{j=1}^2c_j\frac{t_j}{t_j-1+V} =-\frac{\zeta}{u+V}X. \tag{23} \]
记
\[ S_0=c_1+c_2,\qquad S_1=(t_1-1)c_1+(t_2-1)c_2. \]
快根的 \(v=t-1\) 满足
\[ v^2+C_{\rm f}v+D_{\rm f}=0, \quad C_{\rm f}=D+V-\vartheta,\quad D_{\rm f}=DV-\alpha\vartheta. \]
在这些根上，
\[ \frac{v}{v+\alpha} =\frac{D_{\rm f}+\alpha v} {\alpha^2-C_{\rm f}\alpha+D_{\rm f}}, \]\[ \frac{v+1}{v+V} =\frac{D_{\rm f}-C_{\rm f}+V-(1-V)v} {V^2-C_{\rm f}V+D_{\rm f}}. \]
两处分母分别为
\[ \alpha(W-1)(V-\alpha), \qquad \vartheta(V-\alpha). \]
将它们代入式 (23) 并解这两个线性方程，得到
\[ S_0=r_x,\qquad S_1=v_x, \]
其中右端正是式 (16)–(17)。
第一步原始递推再给出其对偶分量：
\[ \eta b r_\lambda =\chi(X-Z)+\eta a r_x-v_x. \]
两个中心分量由同步条件确定，即式 (18)。因此该快分量就是 \(\mathbf r\)，且
\(Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0\)。
最终公式 (16)–(18) 的分母在本任务的参数范围内均不为零，且连续。因此上述矩阵恒等式延伸到快根重合、\(\alpha=1\)、\(\beta=1\)、\(d=1\) 等情形；这里延伸的是已经得到的有限维矩阵恒等式，不需要假定这些端点仍有一组不同的快特征向量。式 (21) 则由式 (18) 逐分量成立。证毕。
引理 3：从 \(k=0\) 开始的瞬态控制
定义
\[ \mathbf r^k:=\mathbb M^k\mathbf r, \]
以 \(x_{\rm f}^k,\lambda_{\rm f}^k,z_{\rm f}^k,\mu_{\rm f}^k\) 表示其分量。则
\[ \mathbf r^k\longrightarrow0, \tag{24} \]
并且对所有 \(k\ge0\)，
\[ \boxed{ |x_{\rm f}^k|\le\frac X4, \qquad |\lambda_{\rm f}^k|,\ |\mu_{\rm f}^k| \le C_{\rm du}bX. } \tag{25} \]
此外，
\[ \sum_{k=0}^\infty|x_{\rm f}^k|\le\frac X\chi. \tag{26} \]
证明。 令
\[ r_{\rm p}:=1-D,\qquad r_{\rm d}:=1-V. \]
二者均在 \([0,1)\) 内。由式 (12) 和常数选择，
\[ \frac{2\vartheta}{DV}\le\frac14. \tag{27} \]
若 \(|t|\ge1\)，则
\[ |(t-r_{\rm p})(t-r_{\rm d})| \ge |t|^2DV, \qquad |\vartheta(t-1+\alpha)|\le2\vartheta|t|. \]
因此 \(Q_{\rm f}\) 在 \(|t|\ge1\) 上没有零点。结合
\(Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0\)，所有快分量都趋于零。
原始快分量满足
\[ \begin{aligned} x_{\rm f}^{k+2} -(r_{\rm p}+r_{\rm d})x_{\rm f}^{k+1} +r_{\rm p}r_{\rm d}x_{\rm f}^{k} = \vartheta\left[x_{\rm f}^{k+1}-(1-\alpha)x_{\rm f}^{k}\right], \end{aligned} \tag{28} \]
初值为
\[ x_{\rm f}^0=r_x,\qquad x_{\rm f}^1-r_{\rm p}x_{\rm f}^0=h_x. \]
基础递推的卷积核
\[ G_j=\sum_{i=0}^j r_{\rm p}^{\,j-i}r_{\rm d}^{\,i} \]
非负，且
\[ \sum_{j=0}^\infty G_j=\frac1{DV}. \]
从式 (16)–(17) 可得
\[ |r_x|\le\left(\frac18+\frac{\xi}{d}\right)X, \qquad |h_x|\le\xi(1+d^{-1})X. \]
故
\[ |r_x|+\frac{|h_x|}{DV} \le \left(\frac18+\xi C_{\rm tr}\right)X \le\frac{3X}{16}. \]
对式 (28) 使用上述卷积核，先在有限前缀上取最大值，再用式 (27) 移项，得到
\[ \sup_k|x_{\rm f}^k| \le \frac{|r_x|+|h_x|/(DV)} {1-2\vartheta/(DV)} \le\frac X4. \]
同样对绝对值求和，
\[ \sum_k|x_{\rm f}^k| \le \frac{|r_x|/D+|h_x|/(DV)} {1-2\vartheta/(DV)} \le \left(\frac1{2\chi}+\frac1{12}\right)X \le\frac X\chi. \]
为控制对偶快分量，定义
\[ e^k:=\lambda_{\rm f}^k-\mu_{\rm f}^k, \qquad v^k:=\frac{\beta(1-d)\lambda_{\rm f}^k+d\mu_{\rm f}^k}{V}. \]
由实际对偶、对偶中心更新，
\[ e^{k+1} =(1-V)e^k+\tau b(1-\beta)x_{\rm f}^{k+1}, \tag{29} \]\[ v^{k+1}=v^k+\frac{\tau b\beta}{V}x_{\rm f}^{k+1}. \tag{30} \]
初始中心差满足
\[ e^0=-(\Lambda-M) =-\frac{\tau b(1-\beta)\zeta}{u+V}X. \]
因此，由 \(\tau/V\le s\) 和原始快分量界，
\[ |e^k|\le\frac54sbX. \]
又因为 \(v^k\to0\)，式 (30) 可从未来求和：
\[ v^k=-\frac{\tau b\beta}{V} \sum_{j=k+1}^\infty x_{\rm f}^j, \]
故
\[ |v^k|\le\frac{\tau}{\chi}bX. \]
最后使用
\[ \lambda_{\rm f}^k=v^k+\frac dV e^k, \qquad \mu_{\rm f}^k =v^k-\frac{\beta(1-d)}V e^k, \]
即得式 (25)。证毕。
4. 新实例、全局假设与全部证书
4.1 显式实例
由式 (21)，定义问题数据中的两个固定向量
\[ x_c:=-\mathcal V(P_0), \qquad \lambda_c:=-\mathcal V(Q_0), \qquad R_*:=\frac54X. \tag{31} \]
取
\[ \boxed{ A(x)=b(x-x_c),\qquad h(y)=\|y\|_2, } \tag{32} \]
以及
\[ \boxed{ f(x) =\psi_{\kappa,R_*}(\|x-x_c\|) -b\langle\lambda_c,x-x_c\rangle, } \tag{33} \]
其中
\[ \psi_{\kappa,R}(r)= \begin{cases} -\dfrac{\kappa}{2}r^2,&0\le r\le R,\\[1mm] \dfrac{\kappa}{2}(r-2R)^2-\kappa R^2, &R\le r\le3R,\\[1mm] \kappa R(r-3R)-\dfrac{\kappa}{2}R^2, &r\ge3R. \end{cases} \tag{34} \]
这里选择的是问题中的 \(x_c,\lambda_c\)，不是算法初值。算法初值仍然是四个零向量。
4.2 全局假设和间隙预算
三段函数在接点处的函数值和一阶导数匹配。径向 Hessian 的特征值为
\(\psi''(r)\) 和 \(\psi'(r)/r\)，各分段上绝对值均不超过 \(\kappa\)。因此
\[ \operatorname{Lip}(\nabla f)\le\kappa, \qquad \sup_x\|\nabla f(x)\| \le\kappa R_*+b\|\lambda_c\|. \]
由引理 3，
\[ \|\lambda_c\| \le|\Lambda|+C_{\rm du}bX \le\frac12, \qquad R_*\le\frac5{12}. \]
所以
\[ L_f\le\frac1{32}<1,\qquad G_f\le\frac5{384}+\frac12<1. \]
同时 \(L_A=0\)、\(G_A=b\le1\)、\(L_h=1\)，满足附件要求的全局光滑性和 Lipschitz 条件。 main
当 \(r=\|x-x_c\|\ge3R_*\) 时，
\[ F(x)\ge \left[\kappa R_*+b(1-\|\lambda_c\|)\right]r -\frac72\kappa R_*^2. \]
右端趋于 \(+\infty\)，故 \(F\) 也满足 Assumption 1。
因为
\[ \inf_r\psi_{\kappa,R_*}(r)=-\kappa R_*^2, \]
且
\[ b\|x-x_c\|-b\langle\lambda_c,x-x_c\rangle\ge0, \]
有 \(\inf F\ge-\kappa R_*^2\)。又有 \(\|P_0\|\le R_*\)，故
\[ \begin{aligned} F(0)-\inf F &\le \frac32bR_*+\kappa R_*^2\\ &\le \frac58b+\frac{25}{144}C_{\rm gap}b^2\\ &\le \boxed{5\epsilon+\frac{100}{9}C_{\rm gap}\epsilon^2} \le\Delta. \end{aligned} \tag{35} \]
没有引入段，因此也没有额外的引入段间隙消耗。
4.3 从零出发的实际轨迹
定义候选误差轨迹
\[ \begin{pmatrix} p^k\\ \ell^k\\ \widehat z^k\\ \widehat\mu^k \end{pmatrix} := \zeta^k\mathbf v+\mathbf r^k, \tag{36} \]
并将复数分量识别为二维实向量。实际变量取
\[ x^k=x_c+\mathcal V(p^k),\quad z^k=x_c+\mathcal V(\widehat z^k), \]\[ \lambda^k=\lambda_c+\mathcal V(\ell^k),\quad \mu^k=\lambda_c+\mathcal V(\widehat\mu^k). \]
由式 (21)、(31)，这四个变量在 \(k=0\) 时全部等于零。
引理 3 给出
\[ \frac34X\le|p^k|\le\frac54X=R_*. \tag{37} \]
因此每次梯度计算都满足
\[ \nabla f(x^k)=-\kappa\mathcal V(p^k)-b\lambda_c. \]
另一方面，对前原始步和后原始步两种 prox 输入，都有
\[ \begin{aligned} \|\lambda^k+\rho A(x^j)\| &\le 2|\Lambda|+2C_{\rm du}bX+\frac54\rho bX\\ &\le \frac13\left[2+b(2C_{\rm du}+5\rho/4)\right] \le\frac56<1, \end{aligned} \qquad j=k,\ k+1. \tag{38} \]
对于 \(h(y)=\|y\|_2\)，式 (38) 精确意味着这两次 prox 输出都是 \(0\)。
于是，候选轨迹在每一步都使用预期的二次梯度和 \(y=0\) 分支，四步更新恰好等于矩阵 (15)。由初值和递推的唯一性，式 (36) 就是实际轨迹。
这也给出了全程有界性：\(x^k,z^k\) 的范数不超过 \(5/6\)，\(\lambda^k,\mu^k\) 的范数也不超过 \(5/6\)。
4.4 原点不是原问题的驻点
这不是把原点放在另一个精确 KKT 点上。
由式 (16)–(18)，利用
\[ \bar u=-u/\zeta,\qquad u^2+\nu u+\nu=0 \]
消去快分量，得到
\[ \begin{aligned} \frac{\eta bQ_0}{P_0} &= \frac{\bar u(\bar u+U)}{\bar u+\alpha} +\eta\tau b^2\frac{\bar u+\beta}{\bar u+V}\\ &= \eta a-\eta\tau b^2 \frac{\bar u+\beta}{\bar u(\bar u+V)}. \end{aligned} \]
因此
\[ \frac{Q_0}{P_0} =\frac ab-\overline{\frac L\zeta}. \tag{39} \]
记 \(\omega=\Im\zeta>0\)。分式分解给出
\[ \Im\frac L\zeta = -\tau b\omega \left[ \frac{\beta}{V\nu} +\frac{V-\beta}{VH} \right]<0. \]
所以 \(P_0,Q_0\) 不共线，且由式 (37)，\(P_0\ne0\)。
原点处 \(A(0)=b\mathcal V(P_0)\ne0\)，因此 \(F\) 可微，并有
\[ \nabla F(0) = \left(-\kappa+\frac b{|P_0|}\right)\mathcal V(P_0) +b\mathcal V(Q_0)\ne0. \tag{40} \]
4.5 对所有 \(k\) 的证书下界
因为 \(y^{k+1}=0\)，残差为
\[ R_k= \max\left\{ |-ap^{k+1}+b\ell^k|, \ b|p^{k+1}| \right\}. \tag{41} \]
可行性部分由式 (37) 给出
\[ b|p^{k+1}|\ge\frac34bX. \tag{42} \]
站立性部分由引理 1、3 给出
\[ \begin{aligned} |-ap^{k+1}+b\ell^k| &\ge b|\Lambda|-C_{\rm du}b^2X-\frac54aX\\ &\ge \frac{27}{32}b|\Lambda|-C_{\rm res}b^2X. \end{aligned} \tag{43} \]
若 \(|\Lambda|\ge X\)，利用 \(bC_{\rm res}\le1/8\)，式 (43) 至少为
\[ \frac{23}{32}b|\Lambda|\ge\frac12b|\Lambda|. \]
若 \(X\ge|\Lambda|\)，则使用式 (42)。两种情况合并，

其中，\(\beta>0\) 时可保证 \(R_k\ge7\epsilon/6\)，\(\beta=0\) 时可保证 \(R_k>2\epsilon\)。
因而，结合已经完成的小 \(\alpha\) 分支，标准初始化版本满足
\[ \boxed{ \inf_{(\alpha,\beta)\in[0,1]^2} \sup_{I\in\mathcal I_0(\mathbf C_0,\Delta)} T_\epsilon(\theta,\alpha,\beta;I) \ge \frac{\Delta}{32768\gamma K_\theta}\epsilon^{-4}, } \tag{5} \]
这里 \(\mathcal I_0\) 表示四个初值均固定为零的实例类，\(\mathbf C_0=(1,1,0,1,1)\)。
以下证明大 \(\alpha\) 分支。小 \(\alpha\) 分支只在最后合并，不重新证明。
2. \(\beta>0\)：参数和旋转模态
以下固定
\[ \alpha>\alpha_\epsilon,\qquad 0<\beta\le1. \]
取参考耦合尺度
\[ b_\epsilon:=8\epsilon, \]
并定义
\[ U:=\alpha+\chi(1-\alpha), \qquad V:=\beta+d(1-\beta), \qquad \nu:=\frac{\eta\tau b_\epsilon^2\alpha\beta}{UV}. \tag{6} \]
再令
\[ \begin{aligned} E&:=\alpha^2+(1-\alpha)\nu,\\ H&:=V^2+(1-V)\nu,\\ J&:=\beta V+(1-V)\nu,\\ W&:=1+\frac{\chi\alpha(1-\alpha)}{E}. \end{aligned} \]
实际耦合系数、辅助量和曲率取为
\[ \boxed{ b^2:=\frac{\nu WH}{\eta\tau J}, \qquad \xi:=\frac{\eta\tau b^2(V-\beta)}{H}, \qquad a:=\frac{\nu(W-1)}{\eta\alpha}+\frac{\xi}{\eta}, \qquad \kappa:=\rho b^2+a. } \tag{7} \]
定义单位模复数
\[ \zeta:=1-\frac{\nu}{2} +i\sqrt{\nu-\frac{\nu^2}{4}}, \qquad u:=\zeta-1. \tag{8} \]
下面的估计保证 \(0<\nu<4\)，故 \(|\zeta|=1\) 且 \(\Im\zeta>0\)。
令
\[ L:=\frac{\tau b\,\zeta(u+\beta)}{u(u+V)}, \qquad X:=\frac{1}{3\max\{1,|L|\}}, \qquad \Lambda:=LX, \tag{9} \]
以及
\[ Z:=\frac{\alpha\zeta}{u+\alpha}X, \qquad M:=\frac{\beta\zeta}{u+\beta}\Lambda. \tag{10} \]
于是
\[ \boxed{\max\{X,|\Lambda|\}=\frac13.} \tag{11} \]
这里的复数用于表示二维实向量。下文使用
\[ \mathcal V(c):=(\Re c,\Im c). \]
引理 1：参数和振幅的统一估计
上述参数满足
\[ \frac{\nu}{\alpha^2}\le\frac1{64}, \qquad 7\epsilon\le b\le8\epsilon, \qquad \frac{\chi}{2}\le D:=\alpha W\le1, \qquad \xi\le\frac1{16C_{\rm tr}}, \tag{12} \]
以及
\[ 0<\kappa\le\frac1{32}, \tag{13} \]\[ aX\le\frac18b|\Lambda|+sb^2X, \qquad \kappa X^2\le C_{\rm gap}b^2\max\{X^2,|\Lambda|^2\}. \tag{14} \]
证明。 因为 \(U\ge\chi\)、\(V\ge\beta\)，由分界条件，
\[ \frac{\nu}{\alpha^2} \le \frac{\gamma\tau b_\epsilon^2}{\alpha} < \frac{\gamma\tau}{16K_\theta} \le\frac1{64}. \]
记 \(\delta=\nu/\alpha^2\)。由 \(W\) 的定义，
\[ D=\alpha+ \frac{\chi(1-\alpha)}{1+(1-\alpha)\delta}, \]
所以
\[ \frac{U}{1+\delta}\le D\le U\le1, \qquad D\ge\chi/2. \]
此外，
\[ \frac{b^2}{b_\epsilon^2} =\frac{\alpha W}{U}\frac{\beta H}{VJ}\le1, \]
因为两项分别不超过 \(1\)。由 \(H\ge V^2\)、\(V-\beta\le V\) 得
\[ \xi\le\frac{\eta\tau b^2}{V}\le\eta s b^2 \le\eta s b_\epsilon^2 \le\frac1{16C_{\rm tr}}. \]
又有
\[ \frac{\beta H}{VJ} =1-\frac{(1-V)\xi}{WV} \ge1-\frac{\xi}{d}\ge\frac{15}{16}. \]
因此
\[ \frac{b^2}{b_\epsilon^2} \ge\frac{64}{65}\frac{15}{16} =\frac{12}{13}>\frac{49}{64}, \]
证明 \(b\ge7\epsilon\)。
令
\[ a_{\rm p}:=\frac{\nu(W-1)}{\eta\alpha}, \qquad a_{\rm d}:=\frac{\xi}{\eta}. \]
由
\[ \eta\tau b^2=\nu W+V\xi \]
可得
\[ a_{\rm p}\le\frac{\tau b^2}{\alpha}, \qquad a_{\rm d}\le sb^2. \]
故
\[ \kappa \le(\rho+s)b^2+\frac{\tau b^2}{\alpha} \le\frac1{64}+\frac1{64} =\frac1{32}. \]
为证明振幅估计，记
\[ E_\beta:=\beta^2+(1-\beta)\nu. \]
则
\[ \frac{|\Lambda|^2}{X^2} =\frac{\tau W E_\beta}{\eta J}. \]
同时
\[ J\le \Re\bigl((u+V)\overline{(u+\beta)}\bigr) \le\sqrt{HE_\beta}, \]
从而 \(J^2\le HE_\beta\)。因此
\[ \frac{a_{\rm p}X}{b|\Lambda|} = \frac{\sqrt{\nu}(W-1)J} {\alpha W\sqrt{HE_\beta}} \le\frac{\sqrt{\nu}}{\alpha}\le\frac18, \]
并且
\[ \frac{a_{\rm p}X^2}{b^2|\Lambda|^2} = \frac{\eta(W-1)J^2}{\alpha W^2HE_\beta} \le\frac{\eta}{\alpha W} \le2\gamma. \]
加上 \(a_{\rm d}\le sb^2\) 和 \(\kappa=\rho b^2+a_{\rm p}+a_{\rm d}\)，即得式 (14)。证毕。
3. 精确满足标准初始化的谱分解
在局部二次区域和 \(y=0\) 分支内，平移后的四变量递推矩阵为
\[ \mathbb M= \begin{pmatrix} m&-\eta b&\chi&0\\ \tau bm&1-d-\eta\tau b^2&\tau b\chi&d\\ \alpha m&-\alpha\eta b&1-\alpha+\alpha\chi&0\\ \beta\tau bm&\beta(1-d-\eta\tau b^2)& \beta\tau b\chi&1-\beta+\beta d \end{pmatrix}, \qquad m:=1+\eta a-\chi. \tag{15} \]
以下构造一个衰减分量，使初始时刻满足 \(x=z\)、\(\lambda=\mu\)。
定义
\[ r_x:= -\frac{(W-1)u/(u+\alpha)+\xi\zeta/(u+V)} {W+\xi}\,X, \tag{16} \]\[ h_x:= \xi\left[(1-\alpha)r_x+ (V-\alpha)\frac{\zeta}{u+V}X\right], \qquad v_x:=-Dr_x+h_x, \tag{17} \]
以及
\[ \begin{aligned} r_\lambda &:=\frac{\chi(X-Z)+\eta a r_x-v_x}{\eta b},\\ r_z&:=X-Z+r_x,\\ r_\mu&:=\Lambda-M+r_\lambda. \end{aligned} \tag{18} \]
设
\[ \mathbf v:=(X,\Lambda,Z,M)^\top, \qquad \mathbf r:=(r_x,r_\lambda,r_z,r_\mu)^\top. \]
引理 2：旋转分量与衰减分量的精确分解
令
\[ \vartheta:=(1-V)\xi, \qquad Q_{\rm f}(t):= (t-1+D)(t-1+V)-\vartheta(t-1+\alpha). \tag{19} \]
则
\[ \mathbb M\mathbf v=\zeta\mathbf v, \qquad Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0, \tag{20} \]
且
\[ \boxed{ \mathbf v+\mathbf r=(P_0,Q_0,P_0,Q_0)^\top, \qquad P_0:=X+r_x,\quad Q_0:=\Lambda+r_\lambda. } \tag{21} \]
证明。 消去两个中心分量后，\(\mathbb M\) 的特征多项式，以 \(v=t-1\) 表示，为
\[ \begin{aligned} \mathcal Q(v) ={}&v^2(v+U)(v+V) -\eta a\,v(v+\alpha)(v+V)\\ &+\eta\tau b^2(v+1)(v+\alpha)(v+\beta). \end{aligned} \]
代入式 (7)，整理得
\[ \boxed{ \mathcal Q(v) =(v^2+\nu v+\nu) \left[(v+D)(v+V)-\vartheta(v+\alpha)\right]. } \tag{22} \]
这里可使用的三个消去关系是
\[ \eta a=\frac{\nu(W-1)}{\alpha}+\xi,\quad \eta\tau b^2=\nu W+V\xi,\quad U-\alpha W=\frac{(1-\alpha)\nu(W-1)}{\alpha}. \]
因为 \(u^2+\nu u+\nu=0\)，式 (9)–(10) 随即给出
\(\mathbb M\mathbf v=\zeta\mathbf v\)。
下面验证衰减分量。先在两个快根 \(t_1,t_2\) 不同、所用分母非零的情形推导。对应特征向量可取
\[ \mathbf v(t)= \left( 1,\, \frac{\tau bt(t-1+\beta)}{(t-1)(t-1+V)},\, \frac{\alpha t}{t-1+\alpha},\, \frac{\beta t}{t-1+\beta} \frac{\tau bt(t-1+\beta)}{(t-1)(t-1+V)} \right)^\top. \]
设快分量为 \(c_1\mathbf v(t_1)+c_2\mathbf v(t_2)\)。它与旋转分量相加后满足两组中心同步条件，当且仅当
\[ \sum_{j=1}^2c_j\frac{t_j-1}{t_j-1+\alpha} =-\frac{u}{u+\alpha}X, \qquad \sum_{j=1}^2c_j\frac{t_j}{t_j-1+V} =-\frac{\zeta}{u+V}X. \tag{23} \]
记
\[ S_0=c_1+c_2,\qquad S_1=(t_1-1)c_1+(t_2-1)c_2. \]
快根的 \(v=t-1\) 满足
\[ v^2+C_{\rm f}v+D_{\rm f}=0, \quad C_{\rm f}=D+V-\vartheta,\quad D_{\rm f}=DV-\alpha\vartheta. \]
在这些根上，
\[ \frac{v}{v+\alpha} =\frac{D_{\rm f}+\alpha v} {\alpha^2-C_{\rm f}\alpha+D_{\rm f}}, \]\[ \frac{v+1}{v+V} =\frac{D_{\rm f}-C_{\rm f}+V-(1-V)v} {V^2-C_{\rm f}V+D_{\rm f}}. \]
两处分母分别为
\[ \alpha(W-1)(V-\alpha), \qquad \vartheta(V-\alpha). \]
将它们代入式 (23) 并解这两个线性方程，得到
\[ S_0=r_x,\qquad S_1=v_x, \]
其中右端正是式 (16)–(17)。
第一步原始递推再给出其对偶分量：
\[ \eta b r_\lambda =\chi(X-Z)+\eta a r_x-v_x. \]
两个中心分量由同步条件确定，即式 (18)。因此该快分量就是 \(\mathbf r\)，且
\(Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0\)。
最终公式 (16)–(18) 的分母在本任务的参数范围内均不为零，且连续。因此上述矩阵恒等式延伸到快根重合、\(\alpha=1\)、\(\beta=1\)、\(d=1\) 等情形；这里延伸的是已经得到的有限维矩阵恒等式，不需要假定这些端点仍有一组不同的快特征向量。式 (21) 则由式 (18) 逐分量成立。证毕。
引理 3：从 \(k=0\) 开始的瞬态控制
定义
\[ \mathbf r^k:=\mathbb M^k\mathbf r, \]
以 \(x_{\rm f}^k,\lambda_{\rm f}^k,z_{\rm f}^k,\mu_{\rm f}^k\) 表示其分量。则
\[ \mathbf r^k\longrightarrow0, \tag{24} \]
并且对所有 \(k\ge0\)，
\[ \boxed{ |x_{\rm f}^k|\le\frac X4, \qquad |\lambda_{\rm f}^k|,\ |\mu_{\rm f}^k| \le C_{\rm du}bX. } \tag{25} \]
此外，
\[ \sum_{k=0}^\infty|x_{\rm f}^k|\le\frac X\chi. \tag{26} \]
证明。 令
\[ r_{\rm p}:=1-D,\qquad r_{\rm d}:=1-V. \]
二者均在 \([0,1)\) 内。由式 (12) 和常数选择，
\[ \frac{2\vartheta}{DV}\le\frac14. \tag{27} \]
若 \(|t|\ge1\)，则
\[ |(t-r_{\rm p})(t-r_{\rm d})| \ge |t|^2DV, \qquad |\vartheta(t-1+\alpha)|\le2\vartheta|t|. \]
因此 \(Q_{\rm f}\) 在 \(|t|\ge1\) 上没有零点。结合
\(Q_{\rm f}(\mathbb M)\mathbf r=0\)，所有快分量都趋于零。
原始快分量满足
\[ \begin{aligned} x_{\rm f}^{k+2} -(r_{\rm p}+r_{\rm d})x_{\rm f}^{k+1} +r_{\rm p}r_{\rm d}x_{\rm f}^{k} = \vartheta\left[x_{\rm f}^{k+1}-(1-\alpha)x_{\rm f}^{k}\right], \end{aligned} \tag{28} \]
初值为
\[ x_{\rm f}^0=r_x,\qquad x_{\rm f}^1-r_{\rm p}x_{\rm f}^0=h_x. \]
基础递推的卷积核
\[ G_j=\sum_{i=0}^j r_{\rm p}^{\,j-i}r_{\rm d}^{\,i} \]
非负，且
\[ \sum_{j=0}^\infty G_j=\frac1{DV}. \]
从式 (16)–(17) 可得
\[ |r_x|\le\left(\frac18+\frac{\xi}{d}\right)X, \qquad |h_x|\le\xi(1+d^{-1})X. \]
故
\[ |r_x|+\frac{|h_x|}{DV} \le \left(\frac18+\xi C_{\rm tr}\right)X \le\frac{3X}{16}. \]
对式 (28) 使用上述卷积核，先在有限前缀上取最大值，再用式 (27) 移项，得到
\[ \sup_k|x_{\rm f}^k| \le \frac{|r_x|+|h_x|/(DV)} {1-2\vartheta/(DV)} \le\frac X4. \]
同样对绝对值求和，
\[ \sum_k|x_{\rm f}^k| \le \frac{|r_x|/D+|h_x|/(DV)} {1-2\vartheta/(DV)} \le \left(\frac1{2\chi}+\frac1{12}\right)X \le\frac X\chi. \]
为控制对偶快分量，定义
\[ e^k:=\lambda_{\rm f}^k-\mu_{\rm f}^k, \qquad v^k:=\frac{\beta(1-d)\lambda_{\rm f}^k+d\mu_{\rm f}^k}{V}. \]
由实际对偶、对偶中心更新，
\[ e^{k+1} =(1-V)e^k+\tau b(1-\beta)x_{\rm f}^{k+1}, \tag{29} \]\[ v^{k+1}=v^k+\frac{\tau b\beta}{V}x_{\rm f}^{k+1}. \tag{30} \]
初始中心差满足
\[ e^0=-(\Lambda-M) =-\frac{\tau b(1-\beta)\zeta}{u+V}X. \]
因此，由 \(\tau/V\le s\) 和原始快分量界，
\[ |e^k|\le\frac54sbX. \]
又因为 \(v^k\to0\)，式 (30) 可从未来求和：
\[ v^k=-\frac{\tau b\beta}{V} \sum_{j=k+1}^\infty x_{\rm f}^j, \]
故
\[ |v^k|\le\frac{\tau}{\chi}bX. \]
最后使用
\[ \lambda_{\rm f}^k=v^k+\frac dV e^k, \qquad \mu_{\rm f}^k =v^k-\frac{\beta(1-d)}V e^k, \]
即得式 (25)。证毕。
4. 新实例、全局假设与全部证书
4.1 显式实例
由式 (21)，定义问题数据中的两个固定向量
\[ x_c:=-\mathcal V(P_0), \qquad \lambda_c:=-\mathcal V(Q_0), \qquad R_*:=\frac54X. \tag{31} \]
取
\[ \boxed{ A(x)=b(x-x_c),\qquad h(y)=\|y\|_2, } \tag{32} \]
以及
\[ \boxed{ f(x) =\psi_{\kappa,R_*}(\|x-x_c\|) -b\langle\lambda_c,x-x_c\rangle, } \tag{33} \]
其中
\[ \psi_{\kappa,R}(r)= \begin{cases} -\dfrac{\kappa}{2}r^2,&0\le r\le R,\\[1mm] \dfrac{\kappa}{2}(r-2R)^2-\kappa R^2, &R\le r\le3R,\\[1mm] \kappa R(r-3R)-\dfrac{\kappa}{2}R^2, &r\ge3R. \end{cases} \tag{34} \]
这里选择的是问题中的 \(x_c,\lambda_c\)，不是算法初值。算法初值仍然是四个零向量。
4.2 全局假设和间隙预算
三段函数在接点处的函数值和一阶导数匹配。径向 Hessian 的特征值为
\(\psi''(r)\) 和 \(\psi'(r)/r\)，各分段上绝对值均不超过 \(\kappa\)。因此
\[ \operatorname{Lip}(\nabla f)\le\kappa, \qquad \sup_x\|\nabla f(x)\| \le\kappa R_*+b\|\lambda_c\|. \]
由引理 3，
\[ \|\lambda_c\| \le|\Lambda|+C_{\rm du}bX \le\frac12, \qquad R_*\le\frac5{12}. \]
所以
\[ L_f\le\frac1{32}<1,\qquad G_f\le\frac5{384}+\frac12<1. \]
同时 \(L_A=0\)、\(G_A=b\le1\)、\(L_h=1\)，满足附件要求的全局光滑性和 Lipschitz 条件。 main
当 \(r=\|x-x_c\|\ge3R_*\) 时，
\[ F(x)\ge \left[\kappa R_*+b(1-\|\lambda_c\|)\right]r -\frac72\kappa R_*^2. \]
右端趋于 \(+\infty\)，故 \(F\) 也满足 Assumption 1。
因为
\[ \inf_r\psi_{\kappa,R_*}(r)=-\kappa R_*^2, \]
且
\[ b\|x-x_c\|-b\langle\lambda_c,x-x_c\rangle\ge0, \]
有 \(\inf F\ge-\kappa R_*^2\)。又有 \(\|P_0\|\le R_*\)，故
\[ \begin{aligned} F(0)-\inf F &\le \frac32bR_*+\kappa R_*^2\\ &\le \frac58b+\frac{25}{144}C_{\rm gap}b^2\\ &\le \boxed{5\epsilon+\frac{100}{9}C_{\rm gap}\epsilon^2} \le\Delta. \end{aligned} \tag{35} \]
没有引入段，因此也没有额外的引入段间隙消耗。
4.3 从零出发的实际轨迹
定义候选误差轨迹
\[ \begin{pmatrix} p^k\\ \ell^k\\ \widehat z^k\\ \widehat\mu^k \end{pmatrix} := \zeta^k\mathbf v+\mathbf r^k, \tag{36} \]
并将复数分量识别为二维实向量。实际变量取
\[ x^k=x_c+\mathcal V(p^k),\quad z^k=x_c+\mathcal V(\widehat z^k), \]\[ \lambda^k=\lambda_c+\mathcal V(\ell^k),\quad \mu^k=\lambda_c+\mathcal V(\widehat\mu^k). \]
由式 (21)、(31)，这四个变量在 \(k=0\) 时全部等于零。
引理 3 给出
\[ \frac34X\le|p^k|\le\frac54X=R_*. \tag{37} \]
因此每次梯度计算都满足
\[ \nabla f(x^k)=-\kappa\mathcal V(p^k)-b\lambda_c. \]
另一方面，对前原始步和后原始步两种 prox 输入，都有
\[ \begin{aligned} \|\lambda^k+\rho A(x^j)\| &\le 2|\Lambda|+2C_{\rm du}bX+\frac54\rho bX\\ &\le \frac13\left[2+b(2C_{\rm du}+5\rho/4)\right] \le\frac56<1, \end{aligned} \qquad j=k,\ k+1. \tag{38} \]
对于 \(h(y)=\|y\|_2\)，式 (38) 精确意味着这两次 prox 输出都是 \(0\)。
于是，候选轨迹在每一步都使用预期的二次梯度和 \(y=0\) 分支，四步更新恰好等于矩阵 (15)。由初值和递推的唯一性，式 (36) 就是实际轨迹。
这也给出了全程有界性：\(x^k,z^k\) 的范数不超过 \(5/6\)，\(\lambda^k,\mu^k\) 的范数也不超过 \(5/6\)。
4.4 原点不是原问题的驻点
这不是把原点放在另一个精确 KKT 点上。
由式 (16)–(18)，利用
\[ \bar u=-u/\zeta,\qquad u^2+\nu u+\nu=0 \]
消去快分量，得到
\[ \begin{aligned} \frac{\eta bQ_0}{P_0} &= \frac{\bar u(\bar u+U)}{\bar u+\alpha} +\eta\tau b^2\frac{\bar u+\beta}{\bar u+V}\\ &= \eta a-\eta\tau b^2 \frac{\bar u+\beta}{\bar u(\bar u+V)}. \end{aligned} \]
因此
\[ \frac{Q_0}{P_0} =\frac ab-\overline{\frac L\zeta}. \tag{39} \]
记 \(\omega=\Im\zeta>0\)。分式分解给出
\[ \Im\frac L\zeta = -\tau b\omega \left[ \frac{\beta}{V\nu} +\frac{V-\beta}{VH} \right]<0. \]
所以 \(P_0,Q_0\) 不共线，且由式 (37)，\(P_0\ne0\)。
原点处 \(A(0)=b\mathcal V(P_0)\ne0\)，因此 \(F\) 可微，并有
\[ \nabla F(0) = \left(-\kappa+\frac b{|P_0|}\right)\mathcal V(P_0) +b\mathcal V(Q_0)\ne0. \tag{40} \]
4.5 对所有 \(k\) 的证书下界
因为 \(y^{k+1}=0\)，残差为
\[ R_k= \max\left\{ |-ap^{k+1}+b\ell^k|, \ b|p^{k+1}| \right\}. \tag{41} \]
可行性部分由式 (37) 给出
\[ b|p^{k+1}|\ge\frac34bX. \tag{42} \]
站立性部分由引理 1、3 给出
\[ \begin{aligned} |-ap^{k+1}+b\ell^k| &\ge b|\Lambda|-C_{\rm du}b^2X-\frac54aX\\ &\ge \frac{27}{32}b|\Lambda|-C_{\rm res}b^2X. \end{aligned} \tag{43} \]
若 \(|\Lambda|\ge X\)，利用 \(bC_{\rm res}\le1/8\)，式 (43) 至少为
\[ \frac{23}{32}b|\Lambda|\ge\frac12b|\Lambda|. \]
若 \(X\ge|\Lambda|\)，则使用式 (42)。两种情况合并，
\[ \boxed{ R_k\ge \frac b2\max\{X,|\Lambda|\} =\frac b6 \ge\frac76\epsilon>\epsilon, \qquad k\ge0. } \tag{44} \]
这个估计包含 \(k=0\) 和全部瞬态阶段，不需要等待快模态衰减。渐近阶段则有
\[ \mathbf r^k\to0,\qquad \max\{|\zeta^kX|,|\zeta^k\Lambda|\}=\frac13. \]
因此，不衰减模态的联合振幅具有与 \(\alpha,\beta,\epsilon\) 无关的下界。
至此，\(\beta>0\) 的整个大 \(\alpha\) 区域已经完成。
5. \(\beta=0\)：原偏差例子的早期界不成立，但有替代实例
先回答任务 (f)。对
\[ f(x)=-cx,\qquad A(x)=x,\qquad h(y)=L|y|, \]
从零出发，只要 \(\rho\eta c<L\)，第一张证书满足
\[ R_0=c\max\{|1-\rho\eta|,\eta\}. \]
它不一定大于 \(c/(\rho+s)\)。例如
\[ \rho=s=\frac14,\quad \gamma=\frac12,\quad \eta=\frac18,\quad \tau=\frac1{100},\quad L=1,\quad c=\frac14 \]
给出
\[ R_0=\frac{31}{32}c < \frac{c}{\rho+s}=2c. \]
所以不能把驻点偏差直接用于所有早期证书。
下面的替代构造对全部 \(\alpha\in[0,1]\) 有效。
引理 4：零初始化下的永久可行性偏差
令
\[ \ell_0:=\min\{1,(2\eta)^{-1}\},\qquad d_0:=\min\{1,\sqrt\Delta\}, \]\[ q_h:=2s+1,\qquad Q:=\rho+q_h,\qquad a_0:=\frac{4\epsilon(Q+s)}{q_h}. \]
取一维实例
\[ f(x)=\ell_0\left(\sqrt{1+(x-d_0)^2}-1\right), \qquad A(x)\equiv a_0, \tag{45} \]\[ h(y)= \begin{cases} \dfrac{q_h}{2}y^2,&|y|\le q_h^{-1},\\[1mm] |y|-\dfrac1{2q_h},&|y|\ge q_h^{-1}. \end{cases} \tag{46} \]
从四个零初值出发，若 \(\beta=0\)，则
\[ R_k>2\epsilon\qquad\text{对所有 }k\ge0. \tag{47} \]
证明。 这些函数满足
\[ L_f,G_f\le1,\qquad L_A=G_A=0,\qquad L_h=1. \]
由于 \(A\) 为常数，
\[ F(0)-\inf F =\ell_0\left(\sqrt{1+d_0^2}-1\right) \le\Delta/2. \]
\(f\) 向无穷远增长，因此 \(F\) 水平集有界；同时 \(f'(0)\ne0\)，原点不是驻点。
现在验证 prox 分支和对偶轨迹。令
\[ r_\theta:=1-\frac{\tau}{s}-\frac{\tau}{Q}, \qquad \lambda_*:=\frac{s q_h a_0}{Q+s}. \]
因为 \(Q>2s\) 且 \(\tau\le s\)，
\[ -\frac{s}{Q}\le r_\theta<1,\qquad |r_\theta|<1. \]
候选对偶轨迹为
\[ \lambda^k=\lambda_*(1-r_\theta^k),\qquad \mu^k=0. \tag{48} \]
它满足
\[ 0\le\lambda^k \le\lambda_*\left(1+\frac sQ\right) =\frac{s q_h a_0}{Q} <\frac12q_h a_0. \]
式 (3) 保证 \(q_h a_0\le1/4\)。因此
\[ y^{k+1}=\frac{\rho a_0+\lambda^k}{Q} \in[0,a_0]\subset[0,q_h^{-1}], \]
确实位于 \(h\) 的二次分支。这证明式 (48) 是实际对偶递推，而非仅在线性分支内形式推导的解。
可行性残差于是等于
\[ \begin{aligned} A(x^{k+1})-y^{k+1} &=\frac{q_h a_0-\lambda^k}{Q}\\ &=\frac{q_h a_0}{Q+s} \left(1+\frac sQ r_\theta^k\right)\\ &=4\epsilon\left(1+\frac sQ r_\theta^k\right) >2\epsilon. \end{aligned} \]
这已经证明式 (47)，与原始变量的进展无关。
原始轨迹也有界。由于 \(J_A=0\)，原始两步对
\[ P(x,z):=f(x)+\frac{(x-z)^2}{2\gamma} \]
单调下降：其 \(x\)-梯度的 Lipschitz 常数不超过
\(\ell_0+1/\gamma\)，且
\[ \eta(\ell_0+1/\gamma)\le\frac32. \]
原始梯度步使 \(P\) 下降，随后中心更新也不增加 \(P\)。因此
\[ f(x^k)\le P(x^k,z^k)\le f(0), \]
从而 \(x^k\in[0,2d_0]\)；由中心凸组合更新，\(z^k\) 也在这个区间。证毕。
6. 端点、交界与最终结论
\(\beta=1\) 已包含在第 2–4 节中。此时
\[ V=1,\qquad \xi=0,\qquad M=\Lambda,\qquad r_\mu=r_\lambda. \]
所以从全零初值开始始终有 \(\mu^k=\lambda^k\)，没有借用非零对偶中心差。快多项式退化为
\[ Q_{\rm f}(t)=t(t-1+\alpha W), \]
上述证明仍成立。
\(\alpha=1\) 时 \(W=1\)，式 (16)–(18) 仍有定义；引理 2–3 的矩阵恒等式和瞬态估计均覆盖该端点。
\(\beta=0\) 由引理 4 覆盖，且对所有 \(\alpha\) 有效。
分界点没有改变：大分支处理
\[ \alpha>\alpha_\epsilon, \]
已知的平台分支处理
\[ 0<\alpha\le\alpha_\epsilon. \]
在后一区域，使用你列为已知的估计，
\[ T_\epsilon \ge\frac{\Delta}{32\gamma\alpha\epsilon^2} \ge\frac{\Delta}{32768\gamma K_\theta}\epsilon^{-4}. \]
\(\alpha=0\) 则由原平台实例给出 \(T_\epsilon=+\infty\)。因此式 (5) 的全部步长量词闭合。
最终机制不是“先把零初值送入原来的特制轨道”。 新问题从零出发时，就具有一个振幅固定的单位模分量；为满足标准初始化而增加的快分量满足
\[ |x_{\rm f}^k|\le X/4,\qquad |\lambda_{\rm f}^k|,|\mu_{\rm f}^k|\le C_{\rm du}bX, \]
因此它在任何早期迭代都不足以抵消证书。大 \(\alpha\) 分支的实际间隙虽然为 \(O(\epsilon)\)，但其命中时间为无穷；最终的 \(\Delta\epsilon^{-4}\) 下界直接成立于固定 \(\Delta\) 预算类，不涉及把缩小的实际间隙替换成常数。可以补全。大 \(\alpha\) 区域存在从全零初值出发的新实例，而且仍可做到 \(T_\epsilon=+\infty\)。 不需要“引入段”：新构造把线性轨迹分成一个不衰减的旋转分量和一个衰减分量，后者在初始时刻精确满足两组中心同步条件；随后通过问题数据中的平移和线性项，使算法的四个初值都严格等于零。
